abstract: Reliable deployment of LLM agents requires grounding diverse user expressions in their environments. Although RL-finetuned smaller large language model (sLLM) agents rival larger prompted LLMs on embodied tasks, their robustness to instruction paraphrases remains unclear. We introduce ALFWorld-Para to evaluate this robustness under controlled paraphrases, revealing 21-52% declines in success rates (SRs), predominantly driven by object synonyms. Despite retaining knowledge of synonym referents, agents often fail to take the corresponding objects even after observing them, exposing a gap between referential knowledge and object binding. Partial observability further complicates binding, as referents may remain unseen or have already been encountered under different labels. To address this challenge, we propose BINDIntent, a training-free framework that probabilistically binds referring expressions to observed labels using semantic proximity and estimated persistence against unseen candidates. Without additional training or LLM calls, BINDIntent improves synonym-paraphrase success of RL-finetuned sLLMs by 17.5-49.1 percentage points (pp) with only 0.4 ms of CPU overhead per step. It also raises GiGPO-7B's overall SR from 61.8% to 77.4%, surpassing a prompted 24B LLM. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/cau-hai-lab/ALFWorld-Para.
summary_zh: sLLM智能体对指令释义的鲁棒性不足，在释义评测中成功率下降21-52%，主因是物体同义词导致指称知识与物体绑定脱节。
部分可观测性使指代物未被看到或曾以不同标签出现，为此提出无需训练的BINDIntent框架，基于语义邻近度与估计持久性概率绑定指称表达。
BINDIntent无需额外训练或LLM调用，将同义词释义成功率提升17.5-49.1pp，且使7B模型整体成功率超24B LLM。

title: Evolver: Turning Agent Exploration into Evolving Capabilities
title_zh: Evolver：将智能体探索转化为可演化能力
abstract: Agent exploration produces valuable procedural knowledge, yet much of this experience remains confined to transient execution traces and is not systematically reused. We introduce Evolver, an experience-driven framework that transforms agent exploration into persistent, reusable capabilities without updating foundation model parameters. Built around structured Gene assets, Evolver integrates experience acquisition, retrieval, and feedback-guided evolution to support experience-conditioned execution across existing agent harnesses. We evaluate Evolver using Claude Code and Codex, two foundation model configurations, and four benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.1, SWE-bench Multilingual, SWE-rebench, and GAIA. On a selected diagnostic set of 320 paired executions, Evolver improves task success from 83.13% to 87.50% (+4.38 percentage points) while reducing recorded task-execution token consumption by 24.24%. Furthermore, among 265 pairs successful under both conditions, token consumption decreases by 17.57%, demonstrating efficiency benefits even when task success is preserved. These findings suggest that persistent procedural experience can improve both task effectiveness and execution efficiency, providing a practical foundation for transforming agent exploration into evolving capabilities.
summary_zh: 智能体探索产生的经验知识易丢失且未被系统复用，需将其转化为持久可复用的能力。
提出Evolver框架，通过结构化Gene资产整合经验获取、检索与反馈引导的演化，无需更新模型参数。
实验表明Evolver提升了任务成功率并降低24.24%的token消耗，证明持久经验能同时提升效果与效率。

title: The Influence of the Inclination of the Accretion Disk in Black Hole X-Ray Binaries on the Energy Spectrum Characteristics
title_zh: 黑洞X射线双星吸积盘倾角对能谱特性的影响
abstract: During the ascending and descending phases of some black hole X-ray binaries(BH XRBs), it was found that the X-ray Eddington ratio ($ L_{X-ray(3-25keV)}/L_{Edd} $) and the photon spectral index $Γ$ had an anticorrelation when the X-ray Eddington ratio was less than a specific value, and a positive correlation when it was greater than that value. Moreover, the cross points of the anticorrelation and positive correlation are different for different BH XRBs ($ L_{X-ray(3-25keV)}/L_{Edd} $ of cross point is between $ 0.1 \% $ and $ 10\% $). The reason why the cross points are different for different BH XRBs were still uncertain. So we processed the light curve and energy spectrum of 15 outbursts of eight BH XRBs during their descending phases. We found that for the same BH XRB, the values of the X-ray Eddington ratio at the cross point are basically consistent for different outburst times. However, for different BH XRBs, there is a positive linear correlation between the X-ray Eddington ratio at the cross point and the cosine of the accretion disk inclination. Therefore, We think that the geometric effect of the inclination has a significant impact on the evolution of the energy spectrum of the BH XRBs.
summary_zh: 部分黑洞X射线双星中，X射线爱丁顿比与光子谱指数呈先反相关后正相关的演化，但不同源的交叉点位置差异原因未明。
处理8个黑洞X射线双星的15次爆发下降期数据，发现同一源不同爆发次数的交叉点爱丁顿比基本一致。
交叉点爱丁顿比与吸积盘倾角余弦值呈正线性相关，表明吸积盘倾角的几何效应对能谱演化有显著影响。
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, Accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal

title: Learning and Steering in Incomplete-Information Games
title_zh: 不完全信息博弈中的学习与引导
abstract: In many modern multi-agent systems, a mediator seeks to influence strategic decision dynamics using only outcome-level feedback and without knowing agents' utilities. In this work, we study how a mediator can learn an unknown game and steer adaptive agents toward outcomes that maximize her utility using only trajectory feedback. The mediator knows the game form and her own objective, but not the agents' utilities. Moreover, she commits to nonnegative payments and provides recommendations and contexts, but receives only a single realized terminal outcome rather than full-information feedback. We develop halving-type algorithms that learn utility differences in normal-form games and conditional continuation-value differences in extensive-form games, achieving a sample complexity of $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ that matches worst-case lower bounds up to logarithmic factors. We then combine these learning procedures with a Lagrangian formulation in an online Learn-Compute-Steer algorithm that interleaves learning, equilibrium computation, and steering toward mediator-optimal extensive-form correlated equilibria (EFCE). With high probability, the Learn-Compute-Steer algorithm achieves a directness gap and an optimality gap of $\widetilde O(T^{-1/4})$, while time-average payments are of $\widetilde O(T^{-1/8})$.
summary_zh: 在不知晓智能体效用且仅获轨迹反馈下，调解人需引导自适应智能体以最大化自身效用。
提出折半型算法学习效用差与条件延续价值差，样本复杂度达O(ε̃⁻²)，匹配最坏下界。
结合在线Learn-Compute-Steer算法，以高概率使直接性及最优性间隙达O(T̃⁻¹⁴)，平均支付为O(T̃⁻¹⁸)。

title: Stress Testing Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Against Covert Misalignment
title_zh: 针对隐蔽不对齐的思维链监控压力测试
abstract: As LLM agents advance rapidly in autonomy, the risk of hidden objectives that bypass safety constraints becomes increasingly plausible. Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring offers a key control mechanism by reading the agent's reasoning and flagging misalignment before it materializes into action, yet its reliability depends on the realism of the red-team it is stress-tested against. Existing red-teaming efforts rely on shared templates, such as casting a side task as a prerequisite, which treat the side objective as an exogenous insertion and leave task-specific, contextually grounded evasions underexplored. We therefore ask: How robust is CoT monitoring against agents that strategically conceal misalignment? To answer this, we introduce TraceMRT, an automated Trace-level Monitor Red-Teaming framework that reframes the side task as a coherent sub-goal of the primary task and searches trace-shaping strategies whose induced trajectories complete the misaligned objective while reading as natural execution. Through black-box attacks on state-of-the-art monitors such as GPT-5.2 and Claude-4.5, we reveal substantial vulnerabilities even in top models. To counter these vulnerabilities, we propose a Bayesian Trajectory Monitoring framework, integrating global context and local segment evidence to detect covert misalignment. Empirically, our method significantly consolidates monitor robustness with 0.91 AUC and 0.74 TPR@FPR=0.05.
summary_zh: LLM代理存在隐蔽目标绕过安全约束的风险，现有CoT监控的压力测试依赖共享模板，难以发现上下文关联的隐蔽逃避。
提出TraceMRT框架，将副作用重构为主任务的连贯子目标，并搜索使轨迹自然执行且完成不对齐目标的策略。
提出贝叶斯轨迹监控框架，融合全局与局部证据检测隐蔽不对齐，显著增强监控鲁棒性，AUC达0.91。
comment: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), 2026. 51 pages, 8 figures

title: Digital Security Under Compound Threats: Surveillance, Threat Reasoning, and Habituation Among North Korean Defectors in China
title_zh: 复合威胁下的数字安全：在华脱北者的监控与威胁推理
abstract: North Korean defectors residing in China face persistent uncertainty regarding digital security and privacy. Through semi-structured interviews with 19 defectors, we examine how individuals understand digital threats and adapt their security behaviors. We identify three interrelated conditions: transnational surveillance pressure from North Korea, identity-linked digital infrastructure and intermediary dependency in China, and threat reasoning shaped by prior surveillance schemas. Participants developed uneven protective practices and followed two trajectories: adaptive habituation driven by knowledge acquisition and erosive habituation driven by the prolonged absence of adverse events. Our findings show how compound threats, attribution uncertainty, and constrained agency shape security reasoning among undocumented users.
summary_zh: 问题：在华脱北者面临数字安全不确定性；方法：对19名脱北者进行半结构化访谈；结论：揭示其理解数字威胁及调整安全行为的机制。
问题：需明确影响安全行为的具体条件；方法：分析访谈数据；结论：识别出跨国监控、基础设施依赖及既有监控图式影响威胁推理三个条件。
问题：保护实践如何随时间演变；方法：归纳参与者的行为轨迹；结论：发现知识驱动的适应性习惯化与无负面事件驱动的侵蚀性习惯化两种轨迹。
comment: Accepted by IEEE S&P 27, Lionel Z. Wang is the corresponding author

title: SKIM: Pruning Large Language Model Agents via Selective Knowledge Informed Masking
title_zh: SKIM：基于选择性知识掩码的LLM智能体剪枝
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed under structured generation, where grammar constraints enforce output format at inference time. Whereas existing compression methods target unconstrained generation, we first identify a fundamental mismatch: under structured generation, grammar constraints reduce the model's output distribution to valid tokens, and the logits matter most at the small set of positions that decide the agent's action. Motivated by this finding, we propose SKIM (Selective Knowledge-Informed Masking), the first pruning and distillation framework for LLM agents under structured generation, with both stages guided by token role. SKIM partitions token positions into context, decision, and format categories, and this partition drives two complementary axes: (1) category-aware pruning saliency scores that preserve parameters most relevant for decision positions; and (2) an on-policy distillation objective that aligns student and teacher on valid tokens, paired with category-aware feature matching. We evaluate SKIM on tool-calling benchmarks and within multi-step agent loops, across multiple model scales and sparsity levels. SKIM consistently improves accuracy over baselines, with its superiority becoming most striking in high-sparsity regimes where conventional methods struggle, demonstrating the potential of category-aware compression for deployment-time grammar-constrained agents.
summary_zh: 现有剪枝方法未考虑结构化生成下语法约束对输出分布的影响，导致与LLM智能体推理失配。
提出SKIM框架，将token划分为上下文、决策和格式三类，据此设计保留决策参数的剪枝评分与对策蒸馏目标。
在工具调用与多步智能体任务中，SKIM准确率持续优于基线，在高稀疏度下优势尤为显著。

title: CST-Bench: Benchmarking Counterfactual Spatial Transition Reasoning with Causal Transition On-Policy Self-Distillation
title_zh: CST-Bench：反事实空间转移推理基准与因果自蒸馏
abstract: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing benchmarks mainly focus on static scene understanding. When objects are moved or swapped, models must infer not only spatial relations but also how interventions change the scene state. To address this problem, we introduce CST-Bench, a benchmark for counterfactual spatial reasoning. CST-Bench contains 7,082 examples covering 6 intervention types and 12 transformation operators, with dense causal annotations including intervention sources, affected relations, expected effects, invariant relations, and metric changes. We benchmark general-purpose MLLMs on CST-Bench and further compare post-training strategies on CST-Bench and standard spatial benchmarks. Results show that methods effective for ordinary spatial reasoning can still fail under counterfactual interventions. We further formulate counterfactual spatial reasoning as causal state-transition modeling and propose CT-OPSD, which uses CST-Bench annotations to guide a teacher model in learning counterfactual state transitions and causal reasoning chains. These chains are then distilled into a student model that reasons only from real observations. Overall, experiment results establish CST-Bench as a challenging benchmark and reusable supervision resource for counterfactual spatial reasoning. CT-OPSD further provides an initial demonstration of how its annotations can support model improvement.
summary_zh: 现有空间推理基准多关注静态场景，难以评估模型在物体受干预后的状态变化推理能力。
提出CST-Bench基准，包含7082个样本及密集因果标注，揭示通用MLLM在反事实干预下推理易失效。
提出CT-OPSD方法，将反事实推理建模为因果状态转移，通过知识蒸馏提升学生模型推理能力。
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables; includes technical supplementary material

title: Unified Overview of Safety Certificate Functions: Techniques from Hamilton--Jacobi Reachability and Control Barrier Functions
title_zh: 安全证书函数统一概述：HJ可达性与CBF技术
abstract: Safety is a central concern in modern autonomous systems. Safety certificates---functions whose existence guarantees that a system meets its safety specification---have long been used as a principled tool for rigorously reasoning about safety. Methods for synthesizing such certificates are scattered across research areas, with little guidance on when to use a particular approach. This tutorial provides a holistic treatment of safety certificate synthesis centered on two widely used families: Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis and control barrier functions (CBFs). For each family of methods, we first introduce its general formulation, along with classical and learning-based tools for certificate synthesis. Next, we introduce two benchmark problems consisting of vehicle systems of differing complexity to assess the certificate quality of different synthesis methods and their effectiveness in safety-critical control. We use these benchmarks to compare various methods and provide practical guidance for selecting an approach.
summary_zh: 现代自主系统需严格推理安全性，但安全证书合成方法分散，缺乏选用指导。
围绕HJ可达性分析与CBF两类方法，介绍其一般形式及经典与学习基合成工具。
通过不同复杂度的车辆基准问题对比各方法，为安全关键控制提供选用指导。

title: Goal-Branching LaCAM: Temporary Goals as Search Branches in Dense Multi-Agent Pathfinding
title_zh: 目标分支LaCAM：密集多智能体寻路中的临时目标搜索分支
abstract: LaCAM is a search-based solver for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF) that runs a depth-first search over joint configurations, using PIBT to generate successors and lazily adding single-agent constraints to explore alternatives. Although LaCAM is complete, it can struggle on dense, corridor-heavy instances because extracting blocking agents from deadlocks requires coordinated moves of several agents, often away from their goals, which PIBT's greedy one-step successors rarely propose and which LaCAM can only reach by enumerating constraints one agent at a time. This paper proposes Goal-Branching, where blocking agents are given temporary goals, each tried as an additional branch of LaCAM's search. We examine random and corridor-aware rules for choosing these temporary goals and show that completeness is preserved for any such rule. On dense instances (60-90% of free cells occupied) of three maze and room maps, Goal-Branching solves 89% of instances against 44% for LaCAM*, and, on instances both solve, it finds a first solution 10-14x faster on maze-32-32-2 and room-32-32-4, and nearly 200x faster in median time at 75% density on room-32-32-4. Solution cost increases by 15-22% on instances both solve, while on open maps and the full MovingAI benchmark its solutions cost no more than those of LaCAM* and it is at most 3% slower.
summary_zh: LaCAM在密集走廊场景易陷入死锁，因PIBT的贪心策略难以生成让多智能体协同避让的后续状态。
提出Goal-Branching方法，为阻塞智能体分配临时目标，将其作为LaCAM搜索的新分支进行探索。
该方法保持完备性，在密集场景求解率与速度大幅提升，且在开阔场景下解代价与速度几乎无损。

title: Embodied RAG++: Retrieval-Augmented Generation From What Exists to What Works in Embodied Scenes
title_zh: 具身RAG++：从物体存在到功能可用的检索增强生成
abstract: To serve a request in a human environment, a robot system must find an object that satisfies a functional requirement and a robot that can feasibly reach it. Scene graphs record which objects exist and where, but they often omit capabilities documented only in product manuals. Retrieval-augmented generation methods can read such manuals, yet they rarely reason jointly over object capabilities, physical instances, robot states, and dynamic connectivity. We introduce E2W-Bench, the Exists-to-Works Benchmark, which links dynamic hybrid scene graphs with real product manuals to evaluate capability-grounded robot--object assignment under availability, mobility, vertical-reach, and connector constraints. We also present Embodied RAG++, a spatially grounded retrieval framework that scopes retrieval to the manuals linked to candidate objects, caches extracted capabilities per product model, and resolves robot--object feasibility through deterministic spatial reasoning. On E2W-Bench, Embodied RAG++ reaches a pair accuracy of 0.90 with Qwen2.5-32B and 1.00 with Llama3.3-70B, compared with at most 0.30 and 0.55 for the baselines, while requiring the shortest preprocessing time among the retrieval-based methods and tying for the lowest total token count.
summary_zh: 现有场景图缺物体功能信息，而RAG未联合推理物体能力、实例与机器人状态，导致难以分配可行任务。
提出E2W-Bench基准与Embodied RAG++框架，通过限定检索范围、缓存能力并执行确定性空间推理来求解。
在E2W-Bench上，该方法大幅提升配对准确率（Llama3.3-70B达1.0），且预处理时间最短、token消耗最低。

title: Enhancing Repository-Level Code Completion with Reinforcement Learning in Real-World Scenarios
title_zh: 基于强化学习的真实场景仓库级代码补全增强
abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) for code, which closely aligns with the practical needs of real-world software development, has sparked growing attention in repository-level code completion. However, existing Code LLMs present challenges in focusing on suitable contexts from the repository and in deeply reasoning about cross-file dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for repository-level code completion. To better understand both in-file and cross-file contexts, we employ identifier-driven intent recognition to capture completion intent, thereby improving the model's performance in real-world scenarios. To enhance cross-file reasoning, we propose a reward-driven completion learning to effectively reward in complex repository completion scenarios. To guide LLMs in completing code that aligns with intended functionality and repository context, we introduce a selective-exploration strategy that directs the model to focus on low-confidence, high-reward tokens, promoting the exploration of valuable, underexplored completion patterns. Experimental results show that our approach significantly improves the performance of Code LLMs. The code and the dataset are available at https://github.com/zhenlongDai/RepoCompletion.
summary_zh: 现有Code LLM在仓库级代码补全中难以聚焦合适上下文并深度推理跨文件依赖。
提出强化学习框架，采用标识符驱动的意图识别捕获补全意图，以理解文件内与跨文件上下文。
设计奖励驱动的补全学习与选择性探索策略，引导模型聚焦低置信度高奖励token，显著提升模型性能。

title: DelegateEval: Evaluating Platforms for Personal External Service Agents
title_zh: DelegateEval：个人外部服务代理平台评估框架
abstract: AI agents that work for an individual over time may also help that individual serve external clients. We define a personal external service agent as an agent authorized and continuously managed by a specific individual to accept client requests, deliver work, and provide ongoing support using that person's knowledge, experience, professional methods, and service boundaries. Such agents could allow individuals to serve more clients with less direct involvement and generate economic value at scale. We propose DelegateEval, a platform-level evaluation framework for agent systems that may combine large language models, reusable skills, protocols such as MCP, and executable tool environments. It covers eight dimensions: ease of creation, service discovery and matching, delivery quality, expertise inheritance, service continuity, learning and improvement, reliability and governance, and efficiency and value. These dimensions assess whether a platform enables people with different backgrounds to turn their expertise into ongoing services that deliver verifiable work, develop capabilities through experience, and remain economically feasible. We present the framework and an experimental design. Complete datasets, executable environments, a unified scoring protocol, and cross-model results remain to be developed and empirically validated.
summary_zh: 【问题】个人代理若为外部客户提供服务，缺乏平台级评估标准。【方法】定义个人外部服务代理，提出DelegateEval框架。【结论】为评估此类代理平台奠定基础。
【问题】需全面衡量代理平台将个人专长转化为持续服务的能力。【方法】构建涵盖易用性、交付质量、专长继承等八个维度的评估体系。【结论】确保平台能支持可验证、可演进且经济可行的服务。
【问题】现有框架缺乏可执行的实验与跨模型验证。【方法】提出实验设计，整合LLM、MCP协议与工具环境。【结论】后续将开发完整数据集与统一评分协议并进行实证验证。
comment: 28 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Evaluation framework and experimental design

title: Learning Multi-Agent Orchestration:Higher-Order Interactions in Policy Improvement
title_zh: 多智能体编排学习：策略改进中的高阶交互
abstract: Learned orchestration has emerged as a promising paradigm for large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems, in which a central orchestrator selects agents and controls the information they receive throughout a task. Despite rapid empirical progress, existing methods train the orchestrator by crediting each decision with its own advantage, implicitly assuming that the other decisions in the episode stay fixed. This assumption fails in orchestration, where the contribution of each decision to the final outcome depends on the decisions preceding it, so the gain of a joint update is not the sum of its per-decision effects. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{IAPO}, an interaction-aware policy optimization framework that explicitly accounts for interactions among decisions. Specifically, IAPO exactly decomposes the performance difference between two policies into the effects of individual decisions and their interactions, which we prove can account for half of the attainable gain, and then optimizes both from sampled trajectories while certifying that every update is an improvement. On long-input versions of GSM8K, MATH, DROP, MBPP and HumanEval, against fifteen published multi-agent and workflow-search systems on the same 7B executor, IAPO's deployed plans reach the strongest system's accuracy with fewer tokens, and removing the interaction term costs 7 to 17 points of accuracy on code.
summary_zh: 现有LLM多智能体编排方法忽略决策间交互，假设联合更新增益等于各决策增益之和，该假设在编排中不成立。
提出IAPO框架，将策略性能差异精确分解为个体决策效应及其交互效应，并证明交互项可占可达增益的一半。
实验表明，IAPO部署的方案以更少token达到最强系统精度；移除交互项会导致代码任务精度下降7至17个点。

title: Transparency in Team Contracts
title_zh: 团队契约中的透明度
abstract: In contract design, the principal is often better informed about the project's chances of succeeding than the agents. To incentivize effort, the principal has two main tools: first, to design a contract, sharing part of the project's success among the agents; second, to design a (Bayesian) persuasion scheme, selectively sharing information with the agents. In this work we are interested in the optimal combination of both these tools. We tackle the joint problem through the prism of simplicity vs. optimality, and establish a stark dichotomy: The simple disclosure scheme of full transparency achieves a tight $4/3$-approximation to the optimal combination of information disclosure and team contract, when the team's production function is submodular. In contrast, full transparency can be arbitrarily far from optimal when production is supermodular. The techniques that we develop to bound the gap for submodular functions, also yield a new deterministic polynomial-time approximation algorithm for pure multi-agent contract design, with a significantly improved approximation ratio of $2.311$, and thus a $3.081$-approximation algorithm for the joint information and contracting problem.
summary_zh: 委托方需同时设计团队契约与信息说服方案以激励代理人，本文研究两者的最优组合问题。
当团队生产函数为次模函数时，完全透明的信息共享方案可实现对最优组合紧密的4/3近似；而在超模生产下，该方案可能任意差。
基于次模函数的边界技术，提出纯多代理契约设计的确定性多项式时间近似算法，近似比达2.311，联合问题近似比为3.081。

title: MEvince: Knowledge-Constrained LLM Reasoning for Technique Identification from Malware Reports
title_zh: 基于知识约束的恶意软件报告技术识别框架MEvince
abstract: Mapping behavioral intelligence in malware analysis reports to ATT&CK techniques supports threat analysis and defense, but reliable identification remains challenging. Supporting evidence is often scattered across long, heterogeneous reports, while closely related techniques share behavioral cues and differ only in subtle but decisive details. While large language models (LLMs) can use external knowledge to interpret reports, they may assign techniques based on plausible associations rather than sufficient evidence. We present MEvince, a knowledge-constrained LLM reasoning framework for report-level malware technique identification. Its core is a shared behavioral representation connecting report observations to technique definitions. This representation is built through agentic mining of technique documentation and supports two online stages: 1) primitive-guided extraction uses behavioral primitives to structure LLM-extracted observations, link them to source passages, and group dispersed evidence; 2) evidence-aligned retrieval matches this evidence to technique profiles through the same concepts, retaining likely candidates and confusable alternatives for LLM comparison of distinguishing behaviors. Controls at both stages validate evidence references and check technique-specific requirements. The representation also supports adaptation without parameter updates, where offline agentic audits diagnose concept weaknesses and refine extraction or retrieval policies. We evaluate MEvince against 11 baselines spanning four method families using a dataset of 610 public malware reports referenced by MITRE ATT&CK. MEvince improves exact-ID F1 over the strongest baseline by 17.4%, and its concept-guided retrieval increases gold-label candidate coverage from 31.6% to 47.9%. With a small adaptation set, offline refinement yields further gains and outperforms baselines that update model parameters.
summary_zh: 恶意软件报告映射到ATT&CK技术时，证据分散且易与相似技术混淆，LLM易凭联想而非充分证据误判。
提出MEvince框架，构建连接报告与技术的共享行为表示，通过行为原语提取与证据对齐检索约束LLM推理。
在610份报告上评估，MEvince的精确ID F1比最强基线提升17.4%，候选覆盖率从31.6%增至47.9%。

title: Signed but Not Safe: Requirement Integrity in Multi-Agent LLM Handoffs
title_zh: 多智能体LLM交接中的需求完整性与签名验证
abstract: Enterprise AI agents increasingly split a user's request across subagents and merge their results, and each handoff can summarize away, alter or ignore a requirement. We report a preregistered study with synthetic, exactly scorable tasks comparing free-text, structured JSON and signed requirement-manifest handoffs: the orchestrator extracts each requirement as a verbatim quote plus a checkable predicate, code signs the manifest with HMAC-SHA256, and deterministic code verifies the merger's decision. With Qwen3-8B (1,440 trajectories, five threats), signed manifests cut unsafe commits under attack from 69.4% to 9.0% (60.4 pp, 95% CI [51.4, 69.4]) with no net loss of conformant commits relative to structured handoffs. Signing is what defeats in-transit tampering: an unsigned manifest committed violations in 79% of mutated runs, the signed one in none. On identical trajectories the deterministic verifier caught 78.7% of violating decisions versus 59.0% for an LLM checker, with 7% versus 50% false alarms. An oracle manifest removed all remaining unsafe commits: the residual risk comes from extraction errors made before signing. A preregistered pre-signing injection attack confirmed this boundary: one adversarial line raised signed-manifest violations from 14.6% to 37.5% (Qwen3-8B), 11.1% to 63.9% (gpt-oss-20b) and 8.3% to 75.0% (GPT-5.6-luna), and the signature then authenticated the corrupted manifest. Signing protects requirements in transit, not at extraction; the extraction step is the trust boundary.
summary_zh: 多智能体交接时需求易被篡改或遗漏，提出基于HMAC-SHA256签名的需求清单交接方法，将需求提取为可验证谓词并签名，有效抵御传输篡改。
实验表明，签名清单将受攻击时的非安全提交率从69.4%降至9.0%，且未损失合规提交；未签名清单在变异运行中违规率达79%，签名为零。
确定性验证器比LLM检查器捕获更多违规且误报更低；签名仅保护传输中需求，提取阶段仍是信任边界，易受预签名注入攻击。
comment: 34 pages, 0 figures. Preregistered; code, task banks, freeze manifests and run logs are available from the authors on request

title: SAVeR$^2$: Reasoning-based Safety Alignment for Large Reasoning Models via Verifiable Rewards
title_zh: 基于可验证奖励的推理安全对齐方法SAVeR²
abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved impressive performance via explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, yet this process introduces critical safety risks. We formalize LRM safety objectives as requiring non-malicious reasoning and answers, safety consistency, and explicit intent identification. We argue that existing alignment methods suffer from poor adversarial generalization, a significant ``safety tax'' on reasoning, and unfaithful coarse-grained rewards, primarily due to their neglect of the LRM's intrinsic reasoning capabilities for safety. To address these, we propose \textbf{SAVeR$^2$}, a novel \textbf{S}afety \textbf{A}lignment method via \textbf{R}ewards with \textbf{R}easoning capability. SAVeR$^2$ decomposes the safety objective into four fine-grained verifiable reward signals and utilizes a difficulty-aware data selection strategy to stabilize training. Crucially, we introduce a reasoning-preserving gradient projection mechanism that analytically resolves conflicts between safety and reasoning gradients, effectively eliminating the safety tax. Extensive experiments on models ranging from 1.5B to 671B demonstrate that SAVeR$^2$ achieves superior safety performance and significantly lower over-refusal rates across multiple benchmarks without compromising general reasoning capabilities.
summary_zh: 大型推理模型因显式CoT推理引入安全风险，现有对齐方法泛化差且损害推理能力。
提出SAVeR²方法，将安全目标分解为细粒度可验证奖励，并采用难度感知数据选择稳定训练。
引入推理保留梯度投影机制消除安全税，实验表明该方法提升安全性且不损推理能力。

title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
title_zh: FINCOSMOS：金融智能体的开放世界评估范式
abstract: Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or a backtest that uses the future yields a report as convincing as a correct one. Existing benchmarks close the world somewhere, fixing the task, the data, or the timeline, and thereby remove these failures instead of measuring them. We introduce FINCOSMOS, an open-world evaluation paradigm for agents doing financial work. A simulated user holds a hidden strategy sampled from a compositional grammar and reveals it only when asked. The agent receives no data, so it must acquire data from the Web, build its own backtest under a data cutoff, and deliver verifiable results. Grading needs no reference answer. Programs verify point-in-time correctness and recompute every reported metric, the delivered strategy is checked against the hidden specification, and a run is accepted only when the user is satisfied and none of 15 veto checks fails. Across four coding agents and a model without tools in 150 sessions, no session is accepted: every session that the simulated user signed off fails a program check, and agents raise only 54--64\% of the details they were not told. Human experts attribute 88.33\% of failures to the agents. With FINCOSMOS feedback, an agent with persistent memory learned all ten tasks.
summary_zh: 金融智能体易产生隐蔽错误，现有基准因封闭环境无法衡量此类失败。
提出FINCOSMOS范式，要求智能体从Web获取数据、构建回测并交付可验证结果，通过程序与模拟用户双重验证。
实验显示所有智能体会话均未通过程序检查，88.33%失败归因于智能体；引入反馈后智能体可学会全部任务。

title: Latency-Aware Adaptive Best-of-$N$
title_zh: 延迟感知的自适应Best-of-N采样
abstract: Test-time compute (TTC) improves language model responses by spending additional computation at inference time, and the right amount of compute depends on the prompt. Adaptive TTC methods allocate compute based on signals of response quality such as observed rewards, often by stopping once the signal exceeds a fixed threshold, and generally measure cost by the number of generations or tokens. But in online serving, latency is also a cost: it grows with server load, so a method using a fixed threshold spends too little compute when generation is fast and too much when it is slow. For Best-of-$N$ sampling, a widely used TTC method, we propose a two-stage adaptive algorithm that draws an initial batch, then uses the observed rewards and the batch's latency to decide whether to draw a second batch and at what size by comparing expected improvement against predicted cost: it draws one when the first batch's best reward is below a threshold that decreases with the first batch's latency, without explicitly measuring server load. We map each reward to its value under the cumulative distribution function (CDF) of the prompt's reward distribution, so the same tradeoff parameters can be reused across tasks; a regression fitted offline on other prompts predicts a distribution for the CDF value of the first batch's best reward, giving the expected improvement in closed form. We evaluate the method by simulation on a preference-based alignment benchmark, measuring generations-equivalent cost: generations plus latency, converted to generations. The method reaches Best-of-$N$'s reward at lower generations-equivalent cost, and conditioning on the measured first-batch latency saves at least as much of that cost as fixed-threshold (latency-unaware) baselines, and more when latency is highly variable, when it grows with batch size, and when the second batch's latency is highly predictable from the first's.
summary_zh: 现有自适应TTC方法用固定阈值分配算力，未将延迟视为成本，导致生成快时算力不足、慢时浪费。
提出两阶段自适应Best-of-N算法：首批采样后，结合观测奖励与延迟，比较预期提升与预测成本决定是否追加采样。
通过将奖励映射至CDF复用参数，离线回归预测预期提升。实验表明该方法以更低等效成本达到同等奖励，且比无延迟基线节省更多成本。

title: Req2Rust: A Requirements-Guided Agent Harness for Project-Level C++-to-Rust Migration
title_zh: Req2Rust：面向项目级C++到Rust迁移的需求引导智能体框架
abstract: Memory-safety concerns make Rust an attractive target for modernizing legacy C/C++ systems, yet project-level C++ migration must balance semantic fidelity with Rust-oriented reconstruction. Source-structure-preserving migration can track low-level behavior, but it can also carry source-language organization, unsafe idioms, and project assumptions into Rust. Direct agent-based translation gives the model more freedom to construct a Rust project, but semantic coverage depends on the model identifying the source behaviors that must be preserved. This problem is especially acute for C++, where source behaviors are often hidden in object models, destructor-driven lifetime protocols, and other hard-to-localize C++ semantics. This paper presents Req2Rust, the first project-level LLM-based C++-to-Rust migration harness. Req2Rust first derives an evidence-grounded Migration Requirements Specification (MRS) that records the behaviors and constraints that must be preserved. It then synthesizes a Rust Design Specification (RDS) and realizes it as an initial Rust project. Because real projects contain implementation details and idioms that only become visible during build and validation, Req2Rust treats the initial Rust project as an executable refinement state. Compiler, semantic, and unsafe-reduction validators produce validation reports for improving buildability, behavioral alignment, and unsafe usage. We evaluate Req2Rust on general C++ projects and modules from the large-scale Openharmony codebase against a ClaudeCode baseline. Req2Rust produces buildable Rust crates in both settings and improves test pass rate from 69.5% to 91.9% on general projects and from 45.4% to 87.9% on Openharmony modules.
summary_zh: 项目级C++转Rust需平衡语义保真与Rust重构，直接翻译易遗漏C++隐含语义，导致迁移语义覆盖不足。
提出Req2Rust框架，先提取迁移需求规范，再合成Rust设计规范并生成初始项目，将其作为可执行精炼状态。
通过编译、语义及减少unsafe验证器迭代优化，在Openharmony等测试中，测试通过率从45.4%-69.5%提升至87.9%-91.9%。
Req2Rust是首个项目级LLM驱动的C++到Rust迁移框架，有效提升了迁移代码的可构建性与行为对齐度。

title: BRIDGE: Bridging the Semantic Quantization Gap for Generative Recommendation
title_zh: BRIDGE：弥合生成式推荐中的语义量化鸿沟
abstract: Generative recommendation retrieves items by autoregressively generating Semantic IDs(SIDs), where an RQ-VAE quantizes each item into a hierarchical SID sequence that the decoder generates level by level. We identify an overlooked bottleneck in this paradigm: the Semantic Quantization Gap(SQG). Quantization derives SIDs from rich continuous signals, including codebook centroids, local neighborhood geometry, and level-wise entropy. However, the decoder receives only discrete identifiers and loses the semantic structure that shaped them. This mismatch manifests in three ways: a grounding gap, where the decoder lacks semantic anchors when target-side information is limited; a neighborhood gap, where token-level supervision discards inter-item similarity and exacerbates exposure bias; and a difficulty gap, where computation is allocated uniformly despite generation difficulty diminishing with depth. To bridge the SQG, we propose BRIDGE. Codebook-grounded latent reasoning injects frozen quantizer centroids as semantic anchors before SID generation. Privileged EMA self-distillation transfers neighborhood-aware knowledge from a teacher to an on-policy student, preserving inter-item geometry while mitigating exposure bias. Effort-aware recurrence allocates more computation to the challenging early levels and progressively reduces it with depth. Across three Amazon benchmarks, BRIDGE improves Recall@10 and NDCG@10 by 10.9% and 9.7% on average over the strongest baseline (up to 12.6% and 10.7%). In a one-week online A/B experiment on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform with 5% traffic, BRIDGE improves eCPM by 0.65%.
summary_zh: 生成式推荐中，解码器仅接收离散ID，丢失了塑造ID的连续语义结构，导致语义量化鸿沟（SQG）问题。
提出BRIDGE方法：注入码本中心作锚点、EMA自蒸馏保留近邻几何并缓解曝光偏差、按层级难度分配计算量。
在三个Amazon数据集上较最强基线平均提升10.9%和9.7%，线上A/B实验使eCPM提升0.65%。

title: MessyNav: Zero-Shot Navigation via Manipulation in Messy Environments
title_zh: MessyNav：杂乱环境下的零样本操作导航
abstract: Real-world environments are messy, with paths often blocked by everyday objects like chairs and toys, requiring robots to perform interactive navigation by manipulating obstacles to clear a path. Existing methods rely on extensive simulation-based learning or per-scene instructions specifying which objects to avoid or manipulate. They struggle to generalize across novel objects, diverse environments, and varied contexts such as a cart of fragile glassware that should be avoided while an empty one can be pushed. We formalize this problem as open-world interactive navigation and present MessyNav, a zero-shot framework based on vision-language models (VLMs). At its core, MessyNav performs explicit VLM-based affordance reasoning before task planning to decide whether to swipe, pick up, or avoid an object and produce a high-level plan. Evaluated on a mobile manipulator across real-world indoor and outdoor environments, MessyNav improves success rate by 27 percentage points (pp) over the strongest baseline in real-robot trials and achieves statistically significant gains in a larger-scale offline evaluation, without task-specific training.
summary_zh: 现实环境常被日常物体阻塞，现有交互导航方法依赖大量仿真训练或特定指令，难以泛化至新物体与多变场景。
提出开放世界交互导航问题，并构建基于VLM的零样本框架MessyNav，在任务规划前进行可供性推理。
该方法决定对物体采取拨开、拾取或避让动作并生成高层规划，无需特定训练，真实机器人试验成功率提升27pp。

title: PSGAgent: Enhancing MLLMs' Dynamic Visual Perception for Panoptic Scene Graph Generation via Agentic Reasoning
title_zh: PSGAgent：基于智能体推理增强MLLM动态视觉感知的全景场景图生成
abstract: Panoptic Scene Graph generation (PSG) requires holistic yet fine-grained reasoning over complex relations among objects. However, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) applied to PSG suffer from a perception bottleneck: they function as static observers limited by fixed-resolution views. As a result, models often overlook critical relations involving small or peripheral objects and struggle to differentiate ambiguous predicates in complex scenes. To address these limitations, we propose PSGAgent, an agentic framework that enhances visual perception for PSG through a think-act-observe loop. PSGAgent allows MLLMs to dynamically refine their visual perception using two tools: a Region Zoom-In Tool for local exploration of small or boundary relations and a Visual Highlight Tool for relation-focused segmentation that filters out irrelevant contextual noise. To optimize decision-making, we construct a two-stage training pipeline. First, we create a high-quality, error-aware Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (M-CoT) dataset that provides robust supervision for cold-start learning. Then, we design a novel hierarchical reward mechanism integrated with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) to enable strategic and adaptive tool usage. Extensive experiments on the PSG benchmark show that PSGAgent achieves SOTA performance, demonstrating strong capability in both holistic and fine-grained scene understanding.
summary_zh: 现有MLLM用于全景场景图生成时受限于静态视觉感知，易遗漏小目标关系且难以区分复杂谓词。
提出PSGAgent框架，通过think-act-observe循环动态优化视觉感知，引入区域放大与视觉高亮工具。
构建含M-CoT数据集的两阶段训练流水线优化决策，实验表明该方法在全景与细粒度理解上达SOTA。
comment: Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026. 10 pages, 8 figures

title: Random Reshuffling for Smooth Convex Optimization: Dominates Stochastic Gradient Descent
title_zh: 随机重排用于光滑凸优化：优于随机梯度下降
abstract: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is one of the most classical optimization algorithms with favorable theoretical guarantees, yet its practical implementation differs subtly from its well-known form and is often referred to as Shuffling Stochastic Gradient Descent (Shuffling SGD). A particularly popular strategy in Shuffling SGD is Random Reshuffling (RR), which has achieved great empirical success. Despite its strong performance, RR has long been considered a heuristic due to a lack of theoretical support. Over the last decade, people have finally established provable convergence rates for RR, thus justifying its observed superiority. However, for smooth convex optimization, two clouds over the convergence theory of RR remain. According to current theory, Shuffling SGD under RR converges only when the stepsize is smaller than a threshold proportional to $1/n$, where $n$ is the number of summands in the objective (or the number of data points). Consequently, the optimally tuned theoretical rate of Shuffling SGD under RR is strictly worse than that of SGD when the number of epochs is smaller than another threshold proportional to $n$. These two restrictions heavily limit the applicability of existing theories and leave a critical mismatch with practice. In this work, for the first time, we prove that RR dominates SGD in smooth convex optimization for any reasonable stepsize after any finite number of epochs, thereby addressing a longstanding open question. Moreover, we establish new algorithm-dependent lower bounds for RR and SGD, respectively. Altogether, these results yield (nearly) sharp worst-case characterizations of RR and SGD. Furthermore, we develop a shuffling-based method to optimize functions satisfying the quadratic growth condition, a strict relaxation of strong convexity, and derive a new complexity bound improving existing results proved under stronger assumptions.
summary_zh: 随机重排（RR）虽经验上优于SGD，但现有理论要求步长小于1/n且epoch数小于n时收敛率劣于SGD，与实际不符。
本文首次证明在光滑凸优化中，对任意合理步长和任意有限epoch数，RR的收敛性能均优于SGD。
建立RR和SGD的算法相关下界，给出近乎精确的最坏情况刻画，并扩展至满足二次增长条件的函数优化。
comment: Extended version of arXiv:2606.32005. Originally submitted to arXiv on September 29, 2026

title: Vis2State: Visual Reasoning through Executable State Abstractions
title_zh: Vis2State：基于可执行状态抽象的视觉推理
abstract: Solving visual puzzles requires both accurate interpretation of visual evidence and reliable computation under task-specific rules. Embedding visual assumptions and task constraints directly in solving code makes the represented problem difficult to inspect and revise independently. We introduce Vis2State, a training-free agentic framework that abstracts visual puzzles into explicit, revisable problem states linking visual inspection and execution. Visual inspection guides state construction and refinement, while generated programs solve the represented problem. The model constructs both the state and the program without predefined puzzle schemas or solving procedures. Inspection and execution feedback allow it to revise the problem representation and solving procedure independently. Vis2State achieves the state-of-the-art performance on four benchmarks. Cross-model evaluation further demonstrates consistent gains. Ablations, error analyses, and fixed-program state interventions further support the effectiveness of the state-centered design. The code will be made publicly available to facilitate future research.
summary_zh: 视觉谜题求解常将视觉假设与约束嵌入代码，导致问题难以独立检查与修正。
提出Vis2State免训练agent框架，将视觉谜题抽象为可修正的状态，连接视觉检查与程序执行。
模型无预设模式即可构建状态与程序，并利用反馈独立修正，在四个基准上达到SOTA。

title: $1/N$ corrections to $\langle TJJ\rangle$ and $\langle TTT\rangle$ in the critical $O(N)$ vector and Gross--Neveu--Yukawa models
title_zh: 临界O(N)与GNY模型中TJJ和TTT的1/N修正
abstract: We compute the subleading corrections in the $1/N$ expansion of the three-point functions $\langle TJJ\rangle$ and $\langle TTT\rangle$ in the three-dimensional critical $O(N)$ vector and Gross--Neveu--Yukawa models. We determine the coefficients of the two parity-even conformal structures and the corresponding conformal collider parameters. The calculation uses an expansion of momentum-space Feynman diagrams in a soft external momentum, together with the contact terms required by background gauge and metric sources. The sums of the structure coefficients reproduce the known current and stress-tensor two-point normalizations. We also compute these coefficients independently using the metric and mixed metric--gauge derivatives of the sphere free energy. Extrapolating the large $N$ results to the $O(2)$ vector model yields reasonably good agreement with recent numerical bootstrap bounds. At $N=2$, our $γ$ and $t_4$ predictions lie within the joint bootstrap region under weaker spectral assumptions; their deviations from the more restrictive interval midpoints are only $3.28\%$ and $4.44\%$, respectively. We discuss the implications for energy flux, high-frequency conductivity, and shear response near quantum criticality.
summary_zh: 为求三维临界O(N)与GNY模型中三点函数的1/N次领头修正，用动量空间费曼图展开与接触项方法，确定了共形结构与参数。
为验证结构系数，用球自由能的度规与混合度规-规范导数独立计算，其求和重现了已知的二点函数归一化。
将大N结果外推至N=2，预测值与数值bootstrap边界吻合良好，并讨论了量子临界点处的能量通量与输运响应。

title: CacheGraft: Enhancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Latent-Space Document Enrichment
title_zh: CacheGraft：基于隐空间文档增强的检索增强生成
abstract: Recent work in machine learning has demonstrated that transformer-based language model agents can communicate state not only through text, but also directly in latent space via key-value (KV) caches. In this paper, we argue that such cache-to-cache translation can provide utility beyond the original motivating application of real-time agent communication and can instead be utilized for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Building on the Cache-to-Cache (C2C) fusion framework, our proposed system CacheGraft encodes each corpus passage offline into a fused KV cache representation between a larger sharer model (4B parameters in our experiments) and a smaller receiver model (0.6B parameters) such that this cache can be injected into the receiver at query time with no need for the larger model. Across five QA benchmarks and two independent locally-run judges, CacheGraft improves answer quality over the text-only receiver baseline in 29 out of 30 comparisons, of which 17 of the 30 are statistically significant. Notably, these gains are zero-shot with respect to the fuser, which was never trained on retrieval data. These initial results suggest that latent-space document enrichment may be a promising avenue for enhancing the performance of RAG systems, particularly in compute-constrained settings where it is only feasible to deploy a small model at inference time.
summary_zh: 传统RAG仅通过文本传递检索信息，限制了小模型的表达能力，需探索更高效的信息传递方式。
提出CacheGraft，离线将文档编码为大模型与小模型融合的KV cache，查询时直接注入小模型。
实验表明该方法在近30项对比中提升回答质量，且无需大模型推理，为算力受限下的RAG提供新途径。
comment: 5 pages. Third KEIR Workshop @ CIKM 2026. Work in progress

title: Adversarial Multiplicity: Cherry-Picked Models and the Limits of Disclosure
title_zh: 对抗性多重性：挑选模型与披露的局限性
abstract: Predictive multiplicity -- where similarly accurate models disagree on individual predictions -- can be leveraged to optimize secondary metrics (e.g., fairness) without loss in predictive performance. However, exploiting multiplicity opens the opportunity for motivated parties (or coding agents gaming their objectives) to steer predictions toward their own ends, such as in litigation or consumer disputes with automated decision-making tools. In these adversarial multiplicity settings, we distinguish soft manipulation, where parties optimize over innocuous model choices (e.g., hyperparameter tuning, feature engineering), from hard manipulation, where parties directly perturb model parameters. We find a sufficiently flexible model can be manipulated to reverse any individual prediction with minimal change in predictive performance while passing black-box audits, making hard manipulation viable in most regulatory settings. Soft manipulation has smaller effects but can pass white-box audits requiring full access to code and data. Even aggregate estimates can be manipulated: a model's estimated effect of climate change on wildfires can be fully reversed by hard edits and soft search. We find the Reconcile algorithm typically resolves most disagreements between models, but more often in favor of the manipulator when the opposing model is chosen adversarially compared to at random. We map which manipulations can plausibly pass existing regulations and disclosure policies, and recommend mitigations such as pre-registration, proof of model training, sensitivity analyses, multi-metric evaluations, and committing to versioned public models.
summary_zh: 预测多重性可优化公平性等次级指标，但也可能被动机方或编码 agent 利用，将预测引向自身利益。
区分软操纵（调超参/特征）与硬操纵（扰动参数），硬操纵能反转预测且通过黑盒审计，软操纵影响小但能通过白盒审计。
现有法规与披露政策难以防范此类操纵，建议采用预注册、训练证明、敏感性分析及公开版本化模型等缓解措施。

title: Designing with Cinematic Language: An Intent-Driven Approach to Human-AI Video Clip Co-Creation
title_zh: 基于意图驱动的人机视频片段协同创作系统
abstract: Generative video models have made video creation more accessible, yet creators still struggle to translate high-level narrative intentions into coherent cinematic expressions. Existing systems primarily rely on prompt refinement or expose isolated camera controls, leaving a gap between what to express and how to film it. We present CineAssist, a human-AI co-creation system that treats cinematic language as an interactive design medium connecting creative intentions with executable video controls. We construct a Cinematic Language Design Space and an annotated dataset from 107 filmmaking sources and 1,436 film clips, linking communicative intentions to cinematic parameter values. CineAssist combines a multi-agent workflow for intent alignment and strategy recommendation with an interactive cinematic editor and a context-sensitive preference learner for user-controlled personalization. We evaluate the system through three studies examining end-to-end usability, cinematic quality, and preference evolution. Results show that CineAssist facilitates efficient, controllable, and personalized intent-driven cinematic video creation.
summary_zh: 现有视频生成系统难以将高层叙事意图转化为连贯的电影表达，存在表达内容与拍摄手法脱节的问题。
提出CineAssist系统，构建电影语言设计空间与数据集，结合多agent工作流与偏好学习器进行意图对齐与个性化推荐。
评估表明，该系统能支持高效、可控且个性化的意图驱动电影化视频创作，有效连接意图与视频控制。

title: EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments
title_zh: EnvOpt：智能体环境的自动化优化方法
abstract: An LLM agent's cost and success depend on its model, its harness, and its environment. In addition to the widely studied directions of parameter tuning and harness optimization, we propose the third direction: optimization over stationary environments. Agents are often deployed in rich environments shared by many tasks, such as a company's Slack workspace or a complex collection of data sources, documents or tickets. We call these environments stationary environments. We introduce EnvOpt, a method for automated end-to-end optimization of stationary environments for any given model and harness, using real or synthetic tasks without needing any graders or reference answers. On AutomationBench, EnvOpt reduces the cost of Claude Haiku 4.5 by 72.7% and raises its pass rate by 14.34%. The same environment transfers to Opus 5, cutting its cost by 68.1% with a 1.34% gain. Added on top of Meta-Harness's optimized harness for Haiku 4.5, it lowers cost by a further 83.4% and adds 11.17% accuracy over Meta-Harness alone. Across 5 benchmarks, EnvOpt significantly reduces the cost of agents while improving or maintaining pass rate, and is transferable to different models and different harnesses. We also discuss common successful and rejected environment optimization strategies during automated optimization. More broadly, our results show that how information is represented to an agent shapes both its cost and its success, making the environment worth optimizing in addition to the parameters and the harness.
summary_zh: LLM agent的性能除受模型和工具包影响外，还受环境制约，但现有研究多忽略环境优化。
提出EnvOpt方法，利用真实或合成任务对静态环境进行端到端自动优化，无需评分器或参考答案。
实验表明EnvOpt大幅降低agent成本并提升通过率，且优化后的环境可跨模型和工具包迁移。

title: WeightLoop: Weight-Space Programming with Experimental Feedback
title_zh: WeightLoop：基于实验反馈的权重空间编程框架
abstract: Weight-space programming (WSP) shows that language models can reason about and rewrite neural network weights; recursive self-improvement (RSI) motivates feedback-driven improvement. Models guiding experiments receive concrete feedback: completed assays reveal prediction errors and inform what to test next. We introduce WeightLoop, a framework that turns experimental feedback into persistent updates to deployed predictors. GPT-6 Astra inspects a task specification and the model implementation, then writes a bounded, reusable parameter-editing program. As new measurements arrive, the program identifies prediction discrepancies, validates candidate edits using observed outcomes, and writes the selected changes back to the original model. The editor remains fixed while the predictor evolves, enabling repeated updates without further LLM calls or gradient retraining while preserving the original inference interface. In offline replay, targeted edits improve mean ranking utility in seven of eight endpoint-budget settings (all eight versus random edits) and mean final discovery across three sequential tasks. WeightLoop connects WSP with an RSI-inspired improvement loop, making experimental evidence a direct driver of model change and subsequent decisions.
summary_zh: 现有权重空间编程缺乏实验反馈驱动，难以实现递归自改进，需将反馈转化为模型持久更新。
提出WeightLoop框架，利用LLM编写参数编辑程序，基于新测量识别预测偏差并验证候选修改，写回原模型。
编辑器固定而预测器演化，无需额外LLM调用或梯度重训；离线重播中显著提升排序效用与最终发现。

title: Take It From Here: Evaluating Coding Agents On Project Takeover
title_zh: 评估编码智能体在项目接管中的表现
abstract: Coding agents increasingly collaborate on long-term projects. When taking over a project, they need to recover currently applicable requirements from the interaction history and update them in response to new requests. However, most coding benchmarks do not include long interaction histories, and some evaluations that consider history still do not cover the full process from requirement reconstruction to project delivery. We therefore provide agents with the interaction history, current request, and pre-request project environment, ask them to make the requested changes, and assess takeover performance through delivery tests. Across six model-harness configurations and 37 targets eligible for executable validation, the mean complete-delivery rate under Full History is only 4.95%. We then use requirement atoms to independently diagnose a larger set of takeover targets, examining relevant information identification, pre-request state reconstruction, and current request processing. We further supply correct pre-request or target states to examine the remaining difficulties in requirement processing and project modification. The diagnostics show that none of the six configurations produces fully correct post-request requirement states, and a case illustrates omission of previously recovered constraints during updating. With correct target states supplied, the mean complete-delivery rate is 8.11%, with build and regression pass rates of 96.40% and 90.99%, but target-test success remains 9.01%. These results show difficulties in both forming target requirement states and implementing supplied targets in existing projects. Based on these findings, we introduce ReqMemBench, which combines requirement diagnostics with delivery validation to support systematic evaluation of project takeover.
summary_zh: 现有编码基准缺乏长交互历史，无法评估智能体从需求重构到项目交付的全过程，故提出新评估框架。
在完整历史下测试六种配置，平均完全交付率仅4.95%；诊断发现无一能生成完全正确的需求状态。
即使提供正确目标状态，完全交付率仅8.11%，表明智能体在形成目标需求及修改现有项目上均存在困难。

title: How Should Agents See Code? Rethinking Code Representations for Agentic Software Engineering
title_zh: 智能体软件工程中的代码表示重思
abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for repository-level software engineering tasks. However, most agents still access repositories through raw files, lexical search, and shell commands, treating code primarily as text. This paper investigates map-based code-representation workflows as a design variable in agentic software engineering, examining how different repository views change agents' retrieval behavior, task success, token use, and latency. In this paper, we study five code-representation workflows: abstract syntax trees, call graphs, module dependencies, documentation-enriched search, and a hybrid workflow that combines them. Each workflow exposes a repository map that the agent can query during a task. We evaluate Claude Code with Haiku 4.5 against a raw-tool baseline on four repository-level tasks: fault localization with LinuxFLBench, repository-level code generation and repair with SWE-bench Pro, test generation with SWT-bench, and security patching with SecBench. The results show that representation workflows are most useful as token-saving tools when localization is the bottleneck, while their success gains narrow when the decisive step is patch or test authoring. On LinuxFLBench, all five workflows improve recall@10 over the baseline (0.757-0.829 vs. 0.717) and reduce token usage by 25-39%. On SWE-bench Pro, resolution remains close to the baseline (44.3-50.6% vs. 49.0%) while token usage drops by 17-26%. On SecBench, Callgraph has the highest patch-resolution rate in this sample (34.3% vs. 28.9%) and uses fewer tokens, but all workflows increase latency. On SWT-bench, Hybrid and Docs have the highest reproducing-test rates in this sample (47.8% and 47.2% vs. 44.7%), but all workflows use more tokens and take longer. Overall, map-based workflows change both what the agent inspects and how much it spends, but their benefits are task-dependent rather than universal.
summary_zh: LLM agent多将代码视为文本，忽视了结构化表示。本文提出基于映射的代码表示工作流，研究不同仓库视图对agent性能的影响。
构建了AST、调用图、模块依赖、文档搜索及混合五种工作流，在故障定位、代码修复、测试生成和安全补丁四项任务上评估。
当定位是瓶颈时，映射工作流主要节省token；当需编写补丁或测试时，成功率提升有限，且部分任务会增加延迟和token消耗。

title: Goal Revelation as a Bridge Between Information-Theoretic Empowerment and Capability-Based Human Power
title_zh: 信息论赋能与基于能力的人权力之间的目标揭示桥梁
abstract: Power matters for AI safety. Optimal agents tend to acquire power across a wide range of objectives (instrumental convergence). As we embed AI agents into socio-technical systems, humans risk gradual disempowerment. Both concerns call for a formal, quantitative measure of power. Two such measures in the context of Markov games are information-theoretic empowerment, the capacity of the channel from an agent's actions to future states, and capability-based individual power, a measure of goal attainment built from the probabilities that a human would attain each goal in a family of candidates were they pursuing it. We show where the two meet. From individual power, Fano's inequality yields a floor $B(s)$. This floor is a lower bound on what we term goal revelation, the mutual information $\mathbb{I}(G;ξ\mid s)$ between the human's latent goal and the realised trajectory. Empowerment caps revelation from above, so that $B(s) \le \mathbb{I}(G;ξ\mid s) \le \mathbb{I}(\mathbf{A}_h \to ξ\mid s) \le \mathfrak{E}_h(s)$. Each quantity can be large while the one below it stays at zero, highlighting the following failure modes. An assistant maximising empowerment can prefer an interface offering broad influence over goal-irrelevant degrees of freedom to one that lets the human attain every goal they might hold. An assistant maximising revelation cannot tell a working interface from one rewired so that every goal yields the wrong outcome, since relabelling goals leaves mutual information unchanged while zeroing every attainment probability. Positive guarantees therefore come only from the attainment end of the chain. A satisfaction floor, computable from two statistics of interaction logs, offers a way to monitor the power users retain in a deployed system, and simulations in random environments show the three quantities are correlated but far from interchangeable.
summary_zh: AI安全需量化权力以应对工具性收敛和人类失权问题，现有两种马尔可夫博弈下的权力度量缺乏统一联系。
通过Fano不等式推导出目标揭示的下界，并证明信息论赋能为其上界，从而建立两种权力度量的数学联系。
分析指出最大化赋能或目标揭示均存在失效模式，仅目标达成概率能提供正向保证，并提出基于交互日志的满意度下界监测用户权力。

title: $D^2$-OPD: Separating Direction and Distance in Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: D²-OPD：解耦外推在线策略蒸馏中的方向与距离
abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model to match a teacher's next-token distributions on student-generated prefixes. Extrapolative OPD further extends the teacher's log-probability shift relative to a reference policy to construct stronger learning targets. However, existing methods couple extrapolation direction and distance, allowing the magnitude of the teacher's shift to dictate how far the target moves. We propose $D^2$-OPD, decoupling these two factors: a per-prefix hard KL constraint bounds the target's distance from the teacher, while an adaptive combination of the teacher's post-training shift and the initial student--teacher gap determines the extrapolation direction. We optimize the student toward this target using forward KL, providing learning signals even for low-probability tokens. We evaluate three settings: where standard OPD performs well, where it struggles with base-model initialization, and where no teacher reference is available. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, $D^2$-OPD attains the highest score in all three settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.45 points. Ablations validate the contributions of each component.
summary_zh: 现有外推在线策略蒸馏（OPD）将外推方向与距离耦合，导致教师偏移幅度主导目标移动距离。
提出D²-OPD，用硬KL约束限制目标与教师的距离，用教师偏移和初始师生差距自适应决定外推方向。
在数学推理基准测试中，D²-OPD在三种设定下均达最高分，较最强基线提升达9.45分。

title: How Do AI Agents Waste Your Money?
title_zh: AI Agent如何浪费你的金钱？
abstract: AI agents may consume massive tokens across a wide range of tasks, but how many of those tokens are really necessary? Although prior work has shown that agents can incur unexpectedly high token costs, we still lack a systematic way to identify and measure token waste. In this work, we introduce a unified framework for measuring token waste across heterogeneous agent systems. Our framework records and normalizes complete agent trajectories, identifies removable spans using an LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaJ), and maps the identified text spans back to the original trajectory for token-level measurement. We validate the identified waste through direct interventions by removing marked spans, resuming agent execution, and measuring changes in task outcomes and subsequent actions. In online pruning experiments, we remove 41-46% of the model's reasoning while largely preserving task performance across two distinct agent benchmarks. Using this framework, we analyze agents across multiple settings. Our analysis shows that token waste has a system-level structure that aggregate token usage alone cannot reveal. First, waste varies more across tasks and agent settings than across models. Second, reasoning and visible execution can exhibit different waste patterns. Third, different harnesses can introduce distinct sources of inefficiency even under the same model and task. Overall, our framework transforms token waste into an actionable optimization signal, enabling researchers and practitioners to train more efficient models, design better reasoning strategies, and optimize agent harnesses toward reducing unnecessary computation rather than merely reducing token usage.
summary_zh: AI Agent消耗大量token，但缺乏系统方法识别和测量token浪费。
提出统一框架，记录轨迹并用LLM-as-a-Judge识别可移除片段，通过干预验证浪费情况。
在线剪枝移除41-46%推理token仍保性能；分析发现浪费具系统级结构，为优化提供信号。

title: SPILLWAY: Separating Target Admission from Sanitization to Defend Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection
title_zh: SPILLWAY：分离目标准入与净化以防御工具Agent提示注入
abstract: Tool-using agents act on email, files, and payments, so an instruction hidden in a web page or a shared document can make an agent send data or money to an attacker. Many runtime defenses put a language model on the decision that lets an action through, so the decision depends on a model that may read the attacker's text and adds model calls to every step. Provenance defenses keep the model off the final check but need a model to plan or route each task first. Where an action goes can instead be read from the tools' typed returns: an email's sender or a payment's account arrives in a typed field, while injected instructions arrive as free text. SPILLWAY turns this observation into a deterministic floor with no per-task plan. The check admits a call when each target value that appears in tool output but not in the user's task was returned by a read-only tool in a typed field or is covered by a fixed delegation rule. A deterministic sanitizer removes instruction-like regions its fixed rules match before the model reads them and retains the removed spans as evidence, and a local judge may restore a refused call, never one whose target lies in the removed text. Across three backbones, and seven task suites on one of them, no standard templated injection redirects an action to an attacker's target under SPILLWAY, at the highest observed mean utility and composite scores (NRP, ERS) of the defenses we run under that attack. A forged chat template also produces a raw zero, and mean in-scope attack success under a released reinforcement-learning attacker is .007. SPILLWAY reaches this floor with no defense-triggered backbone re-run and almost no added model call. As personal AI agents act on users' email, files, and payments, SPILLWAY gives them an auditable refusal floor on where their actions go that keeps them useful and holds across backbones.
summary_zh: 工具Agent易受提示注入攻击，现有防御依赖模型决策或需任务规划，开销大且易受攻击文本影响。
提出SPILLWAY，利用工具类型化返回与自由文本的差异，分离目标准入与净化，实现无需规划的确定性检查。
实验表明，SPILLWAY无需额外模型调用即可将攻击成功率降至极低，且保持了最高的实用性与复合评分。
comment: An earlier version was accepted at the Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (NeurIPS 2026). 16 pages. Project page: https://saintmachines.github.io/spillway/ Code and per-cell results: https://github.com/saintmachines/spillway

title: TileQuant: Tile as the Precision-Allocation Unit for LLM Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization
title_zh: TileQuant：以Tile为精度分配单元的LLM混合精度PTQ
abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces large language model (LLM) deployment costs, but preserving quality requires accounting for uneven weight sensitivity. Uniform PTQ uses one weight bit-width, importance-aware PTQ adjusts scales or reconstructs weights within that width, and column-wise mixed precision retains selected columns at higher precision. However, sensitivity varies within columns, so whole-column retention also protects less sensitive weights, while runtime outlier detection adds decoding overhead. We therefore introduce TileQuant, a training-free framework that assigns precision to hardware-aligned 2D weight tiles. Offline calibration provides input-activation-aware scoring from forward statistics for lower calibration cost and gradient-informed scoring from loss sensitivity for stronger quality preservation. Within each projection's retention budget, the highest-scoring tiles remain at 16-bit and the rest use 8-bit. The resulting map guides reconstruction into compact weight buffers, which the kernel reuses for native integer and 16-bit computation with local accumulation to reduce memory traffic. Experiments show that TileQuant reaches 2.66x the original model's generation throughput. Across language modeling, reasoning, long-context retrieval, and question answering, it preserves quality and surpasses quantized and original models on multiple tasks. These results support selecting precision units that capture local sensitivity while enabling efficient hardware execution. The implementation is: https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TileQuant
summary_zh: 现有LLM混合精度量化按列保留高精度，会保护列内不敏感权重且增加解码开销。
提出TileQuant，免训练地将精度分配给硬件对齐的2D权重Tile，结合离线校准评分筛选高敏感Tile保留16位，其余8位。
该方法使生成吞吐量达原模型2.66倍，且在多任务上保持甚至超越原模型与量化基线的质量。

title: Compositional Unalignment: Auditing Safety in Large Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 组合不对齐：审计大型视觉语言模型的安全性
abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are vulnerable to compositional harm: an image and a prompt that are benign in isolation become harmful through the model's cross-modal reasoning. Recent alignment methods report strong scores on compositional safety benchmarks, but an LLM judge only measures observed behavior and cannot reveal how robustly safety is integrated into the model. We argue that un-alignment provides a complementary audit of alignment robustness. We first show that minimal supervised fine-tuning reaches an LLM-judge score comparable to a multi-stage reinforcement-learning pipeline, so similar benchmark scores cannot establish robustness by themselves. We then show that recognition and refusal of compositional harm are decoupled: nine standard direction-finding methods detect compositional harm with up to AUC=0.99, yet ablating the recovered directions either leaves refusal intact or destroys model coherence. We therefore propose CMaG, a training-free un-alignment method for compositional safety. CMaG measures refusal intention with a refusal-versus-compliance log-probability margin, takes its gradient with respect to mid-layer activations, and contrasts it against partially benign pairs to isolate the cross-modal interaction term. A single backward pass over 80 examples yields a direction along which steering monotonically converts refusal into compliance. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, CMaG reduces compositional safety scores by up to 65 points while over 98% of outputs remain coherent, outperforming gradient-based baselines; the direction also transfers to text-explicit harm and un-aligns models hardened by defensive training. Compositional safety can thus appear behaviorally strong while remaining fragile to targeted internal intervention. Warning: this paper contains unsafe model outputs, including references to self-harm.
summary_zh: LVLM易受组合伤害，现有对齐方法仅测表象，无法揭示安全机制是否鲁棒。
发现微调即可达RLHF相近分数，且识别与拒答解耦，移除拒答方向仍可保留拒答或破坏连贯性。
提出无训练不对齐法CMaG，通过梯度与对比隔离跨模态项，单次反向传播即可将拒答转为顺从，大幅降低安全分数。

title: Not All Loops Cost the Same: Phase-Dependent Depth for Serving Looped Transformers
title_zh: 循环Transformer的相位依赖深度服务策略
abstract: Looped transformers scale inference-time reasoning by repeatedly reusing a shared core, increasing computation without increasing parameter count. Serving prefilling and decoding with a uniform loop budget couples their costs. We present LoopDuet, a phase-dependent depth and training-free serving approach that selects the two budgets jointly while preserving decoding depth at prefilling boundaries. Our vLLM implementation gathers tokens requiring further recurrence into compact batches, turning the selected allocation into executable savings with existing weights and attention kernels. At runtime, a queue-age controller adjusts prefilling depth to retain quality as demand changes. Experiments on the full HotpotQA dataset with one A100-80GB demonstrate two benefits of this flexibility. First, separate phase budgets improve the quality--throughput trade-off: Huginn delivers 19\% more throughput than the fastest tested uniform setting meeting the same accuracy criterion, while a higher-throughput operating point gains 6.04 EM points over uniform depth eight at 97\% of its throughput. Second, the same execution mechanism retains more quality under load: on two evaluated OLMo arrival traces, adaptive prefilling gains 0.92--1.35 EM points over the most accurate tested fixed-depth controls at the same 100\% attainment of a one-second time-to-first-token target. Together, these results establish LoopDuet as a practical way to turn flexible model computation into higher serving capacity and better quality under load.
summary_zh: 循环Transformer推理时预填充与解码共享循环预算会耦合成本，需解耦两阶段计算深度。
提出LoopDuet，按相位选择预算且保留解码深度，通过紧凑批处理与队列控制器实现免训练服务。
实验表明，分离预算使同精度吞吐量提升19%；自适应预填充在负载下比固定深度多获0.92-1.35 EM点。

title: A Complete Equational Theory for Quantum Circuits with Generalized Control
title_zh: 含广义控制的量子电路的完备等式理论
abstract: Controlled subcircuits are commonplace in quantum algorithms as they represent the quantum analogue of branching statements (if then). We introduce a generalization of controlled subcircuits in the form of a binary operation which sends pairs of unitary quantum circuits to a generalized controlled operation, whose semantics are based on matrix exponentials and logarithms. The family of quantum circuits with generalized controlled operations and circuit exponentiation is denoted HQC for Hierarchical Quantum Circuits. We formalize HQC as a modified prop category using a novel category-theoretic construction, and provide a sound and complete equational theory for diagrammatic reasoning in HQC.
summary_zh: 传统受控子电路难以满足复杂量子算法需求，引入基于矩阵指数与对数的广义受控操作，构建分层量子电路 HQC。
为形式化 HQC，提出一种新颖的范畴论构造，将其定义为修改后的 prop 范畴。
为 HQC 的图推理提供了可靠且完备的等式理论，实现了对该类量子电路的严格代数刻画。

title: τ-bench-LILT: Evaluating Conversational Agents on Realistic Multilingual Tool-Use Tasks
title_zh: τ-bench-LILT：真实多语言工具使用对话Agent评测
abstract: Frontier evaluations of tool-using conversational agents are conducted almost exclusively in English, leaving a critical gap for organizations deploying agents in other languages and regions. We present $τ$-bench-LILT, a multilingual extension of ${τ^3}$-bench covering German, Korean, Turkish, and Farsi in the airline, retail, telecom, and banking domains. We natively localize every layer of the benchmark: customer databases are populated with culturally appropriate records, user-simulator prompts are refined iteratively through contrastive annotation by native-language experts, and tasks are updated according to the localized database and to reflect realistic tasks in the target region. Evaluation across eight agent models shows the largest drops compared to English in the Korean and Farsi retail domains, by up to 61 points in pass^4. Code and data released at https://github.com/lilt/tau-bench-lilt.
summary_zh: 现有工具使用对话Agent评测几乎全为英文，缺乏多语言部署评估基准。
提出τ-bench-LILT，对客户数据库、用户模拟器及任务进行原生本地化，覆盖四种语言及四个领域。
八模型评测显示，韩语和波斯语零售域性能下降最大，pass^4最高降61分。

title: IRIS: Intelligent Random Access with Integrated Shared Learning for Decentralized LEO Direct-to-Satellite Uplinks
title_zh: 面向去中心化LEO直连卫星上行链路的IRIS共享学习随机接入
abstract: Grant-free uplink access in low-Earth-orbit (LEO) non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) poses a coordination challenge when multiple UEs share a satellite channel without real-time centralized scheduling under long propagation delays and time-varying channels. Conventional random access does not exploit peer context, leading to collisions and inefficient channel use as contention increases. To address this problem, we propose IRIS, a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for decentralized grant-free direct-to-satellite (D2S) uplink access, with A2A-IRIS as its sidelink-assisted Agent-to-Agent (A2A) realization. Each UE executes a shared binary transmission policy using local traffic/channel information augmented by compact peer states exchanged over UE-to-UE sidelink, while Vanilla-IRIS serves as a local-only ablation. Evaluations in rural and suburban LEO D2S deployments use TLE-based trajectories propagated using the Simplified General Perturbations 4 (SGP4), with a Walker-Delta constellation as fallback. A2A-IRIS achieves 2.1579 and 5.4478 Mbps, corresponding to 99.9% and 96.1% of the respective scenario-specific upper bounds. Relative to Vanilla-IRIS, throughput improves by 40.8% and 325.0%, with collision rates of 0.0000 and 0.0433, while one- and two-epoch delayed centralized schedulers are outperformed by approximately 51--130%. A2A-IRIS also improves fairness, service coverage, and transmission efficiency with moderate Deep Q-Network (DQN) inference overhead. Active-UE load scalability results further show sustained performance over the evaluated load range. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of sidelink-assisted A2A coordination for decentralized LEO D2S uplink access under propagation delay and delayed channel feedback.
summary_zh: LEO免授权上行接入在长传播时延下缺乏实时调度，传统随机接入易碰撞且效率低。
提出IRIS多智能体强化学习框架，通过UE间边链路交换对端状态辅助分布式决策。
A2A-IRIS吞吐量逼近理论上限，显著优于本地策略与延迟调度，并提升公平性与效率。

title: SeVerus: Context-Aware, Gamified Benchmarking for Rust Verification
title_zh: SeVerus：面向Rust验证的上下文感知游戏化基准测试
abstract: Coding agents achieve high success rates on existing benchmarks for Verus, a verifier for Rust programs. These benchmarks typically provide the auxiliary lemmas needed to complete a proof. In practice, however, such lemmas must be discovered and proved. To capture this challenge, we present SEVERUS, a context-aware technique to generate Verus benchmarks that organizes verification tasks into quests, each divided into levelsin a gamified manner. Using the original proof dependencies in verified projects, SEVERUS constructs one quest per verification target and progressively removes proof context to create individual levels. These levels range from the easiest, requiring completing only a single missing lemma, to the hardest, requiring proving the target without any supporting lemmas. An independent checker rejects changes to executable code, weakened specifications, and unsound proof constructs. A noisy binary search estimates the highest level that an agent can solve reliably. Applied to six open-source Verus projects, SEVERUS generates 819 quests comprising 10,095 levels. Experiments with Codex using GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, and with Claude Code using Sonnet 4.6, show that success decreases and cost increases as proof context is withdrawn. The strongest agent solves the final level of 52 of 60 sampled quests, yet can only reliably solve 35% of their levels, with failures concentrated in longer quests. Successful GPT-6 Sol proofs rarely reproduce the withheld lemmas, instead, using alternative proof decompositions. By systematically varying proof context, SEVERUS provides a foundation for constructing verification benchmarks that can continue to challenge increasingly capable coding agents.
summary_zh: 现有Verus基准测试常提供辅助引理，脱离实际。提出SEVERUS，通过逐步移除证明上下文生成游戏化验证任务。
SEVERUS将验证目标组织为探索任务与关卡，从补全单引理到无任何辅助证明，并用独立检查器防止违规修改。
实验表明随上下文移除，agent成功率下降且成本上升；最强agent仅能可靠解决35%关卡，常采用替代证明分解。

title: CosmicGrain: An On-the-fly Dust Physics Module
title_zh: CosmicGrain：实时尘埃物理模块
