Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/non-parametric-memory-relational-reasoning.
summary_zh: 为研究LLM基于证据的关系推理，构建多语言诊断集Rel-Bloom，含450题并按Bloom认知层级与三种事实条件划分。
实验发现模型在Analyze层级准确率骤降，Evaluate层级成瓶颈，且跨语言难度排序一致，反事实语境更难。
结论表明，更强的模型能力并不能保证对给定关系证据的可靠推理，移除实体身份有时可提升高层级表现。

title: Sekai: Incremental Event Memory for Generalized Reasoning Video Segmentation
title_zh: Sekai：面向广义推理视频分割的增量事件记忆
abstract: Online reasoning video segmentation (Online RVS) requires a model to segment query-referred objects as a video streams in, using only the frames observed so far. Existing formulations largely assume a fixed target set throughout the video, overlooking a fundamental property of streaming reasoning: as new events occur, the objects that satisfy a query may change over time. To address this, we propose a new task, Generalized Reasoning Video Segmentation (GRVS), where the target set depends on query-relevant events accumulated over the observed video history. As new evidence accumulates, the target set can evolve from empty to one or multiple objects, requiring a model to continuously maintain target validity while localizing the valid objects currently in view. To evaluate GRVS, we build Isekai, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 videos and 197 queries across 11 temporal query families, with 12,569 scoring points whose target sets are causally annotated over time. We further propose Sekai, an online framework with two complementary components: an Event Memory Reasoner (EMR) that maintains query-relevant events and evolving target states in structured memory, and a Memory-Grounded Decoder (MGD) that identifies valid targets from this memory and localizes them in the current frame. Experiments show that Sekai significantly outperforms existing online RVS methods, achieving 50.33 J&F and improving over the strongest baseline by 3.2 points. Code, example annotations, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/zenastangbi/Sekai.
summary_zh: 现有在线推理视频分割假设目标集固定，忽略了随新事件发生目标集会演变的问题。
提出广义推理视频分割（GRVS）任务及诊断基准Isekai，并构建Sekai在线框架。
Sekai含事件记忆推理器与记忆解码器，显著超越基线，J&F达50.33。
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures. Code, example annotations, and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/zenastangbi/Sekai

title: SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
title_zh: SecureGARD：面向安全工具调用LLM代理的动态本体引导治理框架
abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen. We evaluate \ours{} on AgentDojo, ASB, and AgentDyn under benign and indirect prompt-injection settings. \ours{} achieves a 0\% attack success rate (ASR) across all three benchmarks while improving task utility under attack compared with existing baselines. These results show that explicit semantic governance can strengthen execution security without indiscriminate blocking.
summary_zh: 工具调用LLM代理易受间接提示注入攻击，现有防御方法缺乏对动作语义和状态依赖的显式建模，泛化性差且难以安全更新。
提出SecureGARD框架，利用可执行本体与任务状态推导确定性决策，对未满足可恢复义务允许有限重规划而不扩大授权边界。
该框架离线演化本体以生成动作-状态公理，在三个基准测试中实现0%攻击成功率，且在攻击下任务效用优于现有基线。

title: AgentTrustCI: Build-Time Policy, Grounding, and Trajectory Tests for Java LLM Agents
title_zh: AgentTrustCI：面向Java LLM Agent的构建时策略与轨迹测试框架
abstract: Infrastructure security does not establish whether an LLM agent selected an allowed tool, grounded its answer in tool output, or followed a required workflow. AgentTrustCI is a Java/JUnit 5 framework that expresses these application-layer expectations as policy, grounding, and trajectory checks over recorded traces. A deterministic replay implementation supports repeatable build-time tests; a judge interface provides an extension point for optional semantic evaluation. On 55 synthetic cases spanning seven enterprise domains, the full pipeline correctly classifies all 30 injected faults and 25 passing controls, including ten non-trivial controls, and misses none of 12 designated critical cases. Each single-layer configuration correctly classifies 35 cases because the corpus deliberately isolates ten faults per layer. A grounded answer obtained through a disallowed sequence illustrates the additional coverage of trajectory checks. Repeated measurements quantify validator execution separately from process startup and reporting. These results establish coverage of the authored regression suite, not production accuracy. We describe a production-trace validation protocol, optional LLM-judge integration, and maintenance of expectations as workflows evolve. The contribution is a practical pattern for expressing behavioral contracts within an existing Java release pipeline.
summary_zh: 现有基础设施安全无法验证LLM agent是否选用允许工具、基于输出作答或遵循工作流。
提出AgentTrustCI框架，将应用层期望转化为对记录轨迹的策略、依据与轨迹检查，支持确定性重放与可选语义评估。
在55个合成用例中，该流水线正确分类所有注入故障与通过控制，为在Java发布管线中表达行为契约提供了实用模式。
comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 International Conference on Computer and Applications (ICCA)

title: Where Search Agents Go Off the Rails: Graph-Grounded Step-Level Verification
title_zh: 搜索智能体偏离轨道之处：基于图的步骤级验证
abstract: Search-augmented reasoning systems can reach correct answers while making errors in intermediate steps. Reliable auditing must check whether evidence $D$ covers the question $Q$, reasoning $T$ addresses $Q$, and $T$ is grounded in $D$. We introduce GraphRail, which represents requirements, evidence, and reasoning as structured claims and compares them without a generative judge or gold answer. Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and three reasoning frameworks, GraphRail improves error recall over generative verifiers while remaining stable under stochastic extraction. Its diagnoses can also guide online reasoning, providing a traceable way to detect and correct intermediate errors.
summary_zh: 搜索增强推理系统的中间步骤易出错，需验证证据覆盖问题、推理针对问题且基于证据。
提出GraphRail，将需求、证据与推理表示为结构化声明，无需生成式裁判或金标答案即可对比验证。
实验表明GraphRail比生成式验证器错误召回率更高且更稳定，其诊断可指导在线推理以纠正中间错误。

title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism
title_zh: 基于弹性专家并行的资源高效强化学习后训练
abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.
summary_zh: MoE模型强化学习后训练中，短响应完成后其专家仍被长响应占用，导致大量计算资源浪费。
提出FlexFloor系统，通过联合调整响应调度与活跃Worker组，在同步生成中渐进释放资源。
相比基线，单位占用时间生成的token数提升65.4%，吞吐量提升52.74%，且不影响奖励。
comment: 19 pages including references and appendices, 5 figures

title: SCRUB: Contact-Based Surface-Frame Estimation for Force-Motion Control with an Armless Quadruped
title_zh: SCRUB：无臂四足机器人的接触式表面帧估计方法
abstract: Wiping, sanding, and inspection robots press a sliding tool on a surface with controlled force. Controlling that force needs the surface normal, which is unknown on real-world, unmapped surfaces. Surface-normal estimators can help estimate the surface normal, but they either need a friction model or assume that the instantaneous tool velocity lies along the surface; however, walking violates this assumption. We propose SCRUB, a contact-based surface-frame estimator, which lets an armless quadruped slide a body-mounted tool along near-vertical surfaces in the absence of known, axis-aligned, or vision-predicted normals. SCRUB's predictive controller presses and slides the tool using a Kalman-filter estimate of the normal from two cues: 1) A force cue measures the estimate's tilt across the motion. If friction directly opposes the motion, the cue is zero exactly when that tilt is zero, for any friction coefficient. However, if the cue's sliding direction is wrong, friction appears as a false tilt. 2) A velocity cue measures tilt along the motion. Walking and pressing move the tool in and out. SCRUB therefore subtracts the commanded press rate from the tool velocity, averages the result over each gait cycle, and treats this mean as lying along the surface. On Unitree Go1 hardware at nominal speed and load, SCRUB completed every wall traverse and column orbit. No orbit completed with either cue removed, without gait averaging, or with a fixed normal.
summary_zh: 无臂四足机器人在未知表面滑动工具时，因行走破坏速度沿表面假设，传统法线估计器失效。
提出SCRUB估计器，利用卡尔曼滤波融合力与速度线索：力线索检测垂直运动倾斜，速度线索减去按压速率并经步态周期平均以对齐表面。
在Unitree Go1硬件上，SCRUB成功完成所有墙面横穿与立柱环绕，移除任一线索或步态平均均致失败。

title: Human Motion Prediction via Continual Prior Compensation
title_zh: 基于持续先验补偿的人体运动预测
abstract: Human Motion Prediction (HMP) aims to predict future human poses at different moments according to observed past motion sequences. Previous approaches mainly treated the prediction of different temporal moments as a single prediction task and learned the predictions of varied moments simultaneously, which would encounter a main limitation: the learning of short-term predictions (referring to ``near-future'' prediction) could be hindered by the predictions of long-term (referring to ``far-future'' prediction) motions. In this paper, we develop a novel temporal continual learning framework called Continual Prior Compensation (CPC) to progressively train HMP models, in which we divide the prediction task of motions corresponding to varied temporal moments into several subtasks and train the model in a multi-stage manner. To mitigate the prior information forgetting in the progressive training, we further introduce a learnable random variable Prior Compensation Factor (PCF) to explicitly measure the prior knowledge loss. We theoretically show that the PCF can be efficiently learned together with the model parameters by minimizing a reasonable upper bound of the objective function. The proposed CPC is further enhanced to estimate the prior information loss for each subtask and a new framework called Continual Prior Compensation++ (CPC++) with Fine-Grained Prior Compensation Factor (FGPCF) is finally developed. Our CPC and CPC++ frameworks are quite flexible and can be easily integrated with different HMP backbone models and adapted to various datasets and applications. Extensive experiments on three HMP benchmark datasets using multiple SOTA HMP backbones (PGBIG, siMLPe, MotionMixer, and LTD) demonstrate the effectiveness and flexibility of our frameworks.
summary_zh: 现有HMP将不同时刻预测作为单一任务同时学习，导致短期预测受长期预测阻碍。
提出持续先验补偿框架CPC，将预测分多阶段渐进训练，并引入PCF显式衡量先验知识损失。
进一步提出CPC++框架使用细粒度FGPCF，在三个基准数据集及多种SOTA骨干模型上验证了有效性与灵活性。
journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (2026)

title: Trick-or-Treat: Adversarial Evaluation of Multimodal Medical Reasoning with Synthetic Images
title_zh: Trick-or-Treat：基于合成图像的多模态医学推理对抗评估
abstract: We used medical image synthesis to create a challenging multimodal evaluation framework that exposes hallucination behaviors in frontier models. Evaluating multimodal reasoning has historically been difficult because existing medical datasets rarely pair different image modalities, such as radiographs and external clinical photographs. To address this gap, we introduce Trick-or-Treat, an adversarial multimodal medical benchmark that pairs real chest radiographs with synthetic clinical photographs to challenge models' cross-modal reasoning. For each of a wide range of conditions, we created two pairs of images, where the pairs share a single chest radiograph but contain different external photographs. In matched pairs, the chest radiograph and photograph both contain findings suggesting the same disease (e.g., varicella pneumonia suggested by lung opacities and crusted skin lesions seen in chickenpox). In mismatched pairs, the photograph depicts an alternative clinical finding that would not lead to the same unifying diagnosis (e.g. replacing crusted skin lesions with ordinary acne). Synthetic photograph generation allows clinical findings to be varied while the person's features and photographic setting stay consistent, reducing confounding. In an investigation of three frontier models, we found that models hallucinated clinically significant photograph findings in 45-57.5% of mismatched pairs, up from 25-37.5% for the same photographs shown alone. When faced with mismatched pairs, models tended to ignore mismatches and instead hallucinated findings that better matched the radiograph (e.g. misreading acne as crusted skin lesions to justify diagnosing chickenpox). Trick-or-Treat both demonstrates concerning error pattern in frontier models' medical reasoning and provides a proof of concept for the use of synthetic images in adversarial multimodal evaluation.
summary_zh: 现有医学数据集缺乏不同模态图像配对，难以评估多模态推理。
提出Trick-or-Treat基准，将真实胸片与合成临床照片配对，构建匹配与不匹配对以测试跨模态推理。
前沿模型在不匹配对中45-57.5%产生幻觉，倾向忽略矛盾并捏造与胸片一致的发现。

title: From Certified Pairs to a Certified Hub: Reasoner-Checked Crosswalks for the Information Exchange Standard
title_zh: 从认证对到认证中心：信息交换标准的推理校验交叉映射
abstract: A national digital twin was conceived as an ecosystem of twins connected through mappings to a common foundation, but the roadmap that promises to confirm those mappings are valid never says what valid means. We give the test a precise form, coherence and conservativity of the merged ontology, borrowed from logic-based alignment repair, and apply it to the Information Exchange Standard (IES), first pair by pair and then to whole hubs. Crosswalks from IES into thirteen ontologies across seven sector groups, anchored on the building ontologies BOT, Brick, and SAREF4BLDG, pass through separate stages of matching, human review, certification of each SKOS correspondence against the two class hierarchies, and reasoning with HermiT. Pair by pair, the stages catch different failures: certification alone removed all 526 conservativity violations of the raw crosswalks, review alone left 73, and together they made eleven of twelve overlapping pairs coherent and conservative. Pairwise certification does not compose. Merging the three certified building crosswalks into one hub made five Brick classes unsatisfiable, through a homonym between the IES and Brick notions of a floor that only BOT's disjointness axioms expose; rejecting that one row gave a coherent and conservative hub that entails 290 cross-ontology links nobody wrote down. The core hub is inconsistent before any crosswalk is added, because two published standards, the Open Energy Ontology and BFO 2020, contradict each other; with either one left out it is coherent and conservative. A hub, not a pair, is the unit an ecosystem of twins has to certify.
summary_zh: 数字孪生生态的映射有效性缺乏明确定义，借用逻辑对齐修复提出一致性与保守性测试，应用于信息交换标准（IES）。
对IES的13个交叉映射逐对执行匹配、人工审查、SKOS认证与推理，认证与审查结合使11个重叠对实现一致且保守。
逐对认证无法组合，合并时发现同义词冲突与核心中心不一致，证明孪生生态的认证单元必须是中心而非对。

title: Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency: Test-Time Reasoning with Imperfect Generators and Verifiers
title_zh: 验证器引导的自一致性：不完美生成器与验证器的测试时推理
abstract: Large language models can solve many multi-step reasoning problems, but their reasoning remains brittle: plausible intermediate steps often lead to incorrect answers. Improving reasoning at test time requires balancing two imperfect signals: the generator, which provides diversity, and the verifier, which guides correctness. Existing approaches largely favor one side of this tradeoff. Verifier-weighted voting relies on trajectories sampled from the generator and cannot steer generation toward correct ones. By contrast, beam-style verifier-guided search can steer generation, but may over-concentrate on narrow trajectory sets and amplify verifier errors. We propose Verifier-Guided Self-Consistency (VGSC), a stochastic decoding framework that combines step-level correctness and future-outcome estimates to guide reasoning during generation. VGSC repeatedly proposes candidate next steps from the base language model and uses both signals in an acceptance/resampling procedure, while maintaining multiple trajectories for final answer-level self-consistency. We provide a probabilistic interpretation of VGSC as approximate sampling from a verifier-tilted trajectory distribution. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, generator models, and verifier families, VGSC achieves higher average accuracy than representative baselines.
summary_zh: LLM多步推理易出错，现有测试时推理方法难以平衡生成器多样性与验证器正确性。
提出VGSC框架，在生成中结合步骤正确性与结果估计，通过接受/重采样引导推理。
VGSC在多基准测试中准确率优于基线，可近似视为从验证器倾斜的轨迹分布中采样。

title: SpikePose: Lightweight Video Human Pose Estimation
title_zh: SpikePose：轻量级视频人体姿态估计
abstract: Efficient video human pose estimation must balance localisation accuracy, motion quality, and energy cost. We present SpikePose, a lightweight video pose estimator that pairs a frame-reset, single-step spiking encoder with motion-aligned heatmap memory (MAM). The encoder supplies per-frame spatial evidence, while MAM estimates joint displacement, aligns historical heatmaps, and adaptively fuses them with current predictions. By confining temporal reasoning to a compact, lightweight module outside the spiking backbone, SpikePose helps bridge the gap between spiking and classical Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) on large-scale, non-event-driven video tasks. We evaluate spatial accuracy, motion errors, and estimated arithmetic energy on MPII and a fixed NTU60 Cross-Subject subset. Against the architecture-matched ANN with MAM, SpikePose cuts estimated arithmetic energy by 91.4% at a cost of just 1.12 points in head-bone-normalised PCK at 0.5 threshold (PCK_HB(0.5)). Within SpikePose, adding MAM reduces velocity and acceleration errors by 28.13% and 31.46% while slightly improving localisation, at a cost of only 0.003M parameters and 0.0023 analytical GFLOPs per frame. Code will be released on GitHub upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 视频姿态估计需平衡定位精度、运动质量与能耗，现有方法难以兼顾。
提出SpikePose，结合帧复位单步脉冲编码器与运动对齐热图记忆（MAM）模块，将时序推理置于脉冲主干外以融合时空特征。
相比同架构ANN，能耗降低91.4%且精度仅降1.12；引入MAM以极小开销使运动误差降约30%，弥合了脉冲与经典ANN的差距。

title: Signed, Sealed, Leaked: Trust Beyond Signature for MCP Toolchains
title_zh: MCP工具链的签名信任失效与胚系执行防御
abstract: AI agents rely on third-party tools, such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, whose publishers can be authenticated and whose execution can be restricted by runtime security policies. Yet authenticity does not guarantee benign behaviour: a legitimately signed tool may perform its advertised function while concealing malicious code that leaks confidential information. We demonstrate this trust failure with a signed MCP tool that embeds sensitive data in requests to a policy-allowed destination. Meta's MCPGuard-Dynamic, a state-of-the-art runtime defence, blocks a direct exfiltration attempt in the same run, yet fails to prevent this attack in every trial. We introduce germline execution, which limits information disclosure without inspecting or trusting tool implementations. Each tool invocation runs in ephemeral copies forked from a data-free germline process, each receiving only information authorised for its destination. Even if malicious code executes, what it can disclose is bounded by the data available to its copy. Under explicit assumptions on copy confinement and a data-free germline, we prove sink noninterference for every signed release and, for releases deterministic within our replay model, show that a verified witness establishes a flow violation. Across 153 attack runs, no unauthorised disclosure was detected under germline execution, compared with 5.9-74.5% of runs under baseline defences and an ablation. Invocations served by a single copy completed in 10-49 ms, 2-28x faster than restarting the tool for every invocation, the conventional way to clear state. These results show that data-isolated execution protects agent toolchains against malicious code concealed within authenticated software.
summary_zh: 已签名的MCP工具可能隐藏恶意代码泄露数据，现有运行时防御无法有效阻止此类攻击。
提出胚系执行方法，在无数据胚系进程的临时副本中运行工具，仅授权目标所需信息。
该方法证明了接收器非干扰性，实验中零未授权泄露，且比重启工具快2-28倍。

title: Does Personality Persuade? Investigating Personality Trait Prompting and Persuasion in Large Language Models
title_zh: 大语言模型的人格特质提示与说服力研究
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can be prompted to express different personality profiles, but it remains unclear how reliably they do so or whether personality affects their persuasiveness. We investigate these questions in two evaluations. First, we assess Big Five personality prompting using the IPIP-NEO-120, examining reproducibility, trait controllability, cross-trait effects, and unconditioned model profiles. Second, we conduct a within-subjects user study (N=32) in which participants discuss moral dilemmas with LLM agents whose personalities are aligned, mismatched, neutral, or unconditioned. We find that prompted profiles can be reproducible and responsive to requested traits, although controllability varies across models and changes to one trait can affect others. Unconditioned models also exhibit systematic personality profiles rather than neutral baselines. In the user study, personality alignment did not significantly affect perceived persuasiveness, stance switching, or confidence changes. Participants switched their initial stance in only 8 of 128 conversations, while confidence changes were more common. Participants' Big Five traits were not significantly associated with susceptibility to persuasion, but higher self-reported AI persuasion literacy was associated with less frequent confidence changes. Exploratory analysis showed that logical appeals dominated agent messages. These findings distinguish technical control over prompted LLM personality from observable influence on users and motivate evaluating persuasive interactions beyond explicit changes in decisions.
summary_zh: LLM人格提示的可靠性与说服力影响尚不明确，通过量表评估和用户研究探究其可控性及对用户说服效果。
量表评估发现LLM人格提示具可复现性，但可控性因模型而异且存在跨特质影响，无提示模型也展现系统性人格。
用户研究表明，人格匹配未显著影响LLM说服力，用户立场极少改变；AI说服素养越高，信心变化越少。

title: From Vision to Context: A Review of Prompt-Driven Target Volume Segmentation in Radiotherapy
title_zh: 从视觉到上下文：放疗中提示驱动靶区分割综述
abstract: Accurate target volume (TV) segmentation is essential for radiotherapy (RT) planning but remains time-consuming. Moreover, the final contour depends on the expertise of the radiation oncologist. Although deep learning has improved medical image segmentation, image-only models cannot encode the clinical reasoning that governs TV delineation, particularly for the clinical target volume (CTV), where boundaries are defined by clinical knowledge rather than imaging features alone. Prompt-driven segmentation has recently emerged as a strategy to address this limitation. This work aims to review these approaches for RT TV segmentation with four objectives: (1) compare the different prompting techniques used; (2) compare their performance against image-only baselines; (3) assess how they are evaluated against standard metrics, including the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), 95th Hausdorff distance, sensitivity, precision, and clinical assessment; and (4) identify the gaps needed for clinical translation. We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, and arXiv for studies incorporating geometric, clinical text, or interactive prompts into deep learning models for RT TV delineation. Thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria, spanning head and neck, breast, prostate, lung, cervix, and rectal cancers. Seven studies used clinical text prompting, four used geometric prompting, and two used interactive prompting; three combined modalities. Reported DSC ranged from 0.67 to 0.93, compared to 0.65 to 0.91 for image-only baselines. None reported sensitivity or precision. Clinical text prompting appears well suited to CTV delineation. Evidence remains limited, and standardized prompt engineering and clinical validation are needed before these approaches can be translated into routine RT practice.
summary_zh: 纯图像深度学习模型无法编码CTV边界依赖的临床推理，导致放疗靶区分割受限。
系统回顾13项研究，对比几何、临床文本及交互式提示技术在放疗靶区分割中的应用与性能。
提示驱动方法DSC达0.67-0.93，优于纯图像基线；临床文本提示适合CTV，但临床转化仍需标准化验证。
comment: Submitted to Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics

title: One Scale, Four Texts: Gaps, Overlaps and Silent Repairs in Published Grading Schemes
title_zh: 单一分级标准下四版文本的缺陷、重叠与隐性修复
abstract: Category systems often reach their users as text, and readers apply them with tacit repairs. We ask what such a text determines once the repairs are removed, using diabetic retinopathy grading, where one international scale circulates in several documents. We transcribe four texts (the English screening definitions of 2025, the international scale as tabulated in 2017 and as published in 2003, and an Italian guideline of 2015) into one rule language over 24 finding variables, and make every point a text leaves open a named precisification. Exhaustive enumeration of 1,425,807,360 finding profiles, re-derived by an SMT solver and spot-checked by an OWL reasoner, shows that every text that assigns actions leaves some eyes without a category under every reading; that the 2017 tabulation has a proliferative class that is empty when read literally and a macular gap that the 2003 text lacks, so that no function maps the 2003 grades onto the 2017 grades; and that on image findings alone the English and Italian texts order some pairs of eyes in opposite ways. On 927 annotated photographs from three public datasets, with retinal thickening assumed absent, the English text and the 2017 tabulation disagree on referral for 26.8% of the eyes of one dataset (DDR) on which both decide, and in a pre-registered experiment classifiers trained on each text's labels side with their own text. Thickening cannot be seen on a colour photograph; left free, every disagreement involving England becomes undecidable, so it rests on what the camera cannot show. In a second pre-registered study, language models that answered without deliberating repaired most gap and overlap items even when told to read literally, while Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5 reported the defects far more often; within two models, deliberation reduced silent repair without removing it.
summary_zh: 问题：分级标准文本常存在歧义，用户会隐性修复。方法：将糖尿病视网膜病变的4版分级文本转录为规则语言并用SMT求解器枚举。结论：所有文本均存在未覆盖的病例，且不同版本间无法映射，英意文本甚至对病例排序相反。
问题：不同文本对同一病例的决策是否一致。方法：在927张标注照片上对比英国文本与2017年表格的转诊建议，并按各自标签训练分类器。结论：两文本在DDR数据集上26.8%的病例转诊意见不合，分类器倾向支持各自文本的判定。
问题：隐性修复与不可见特征如何影响决策。方法：分析视网膜增厚（照片不可见）对分歧的影响，并测试LLM对文本缺陷的识别。结论：涉及英国的分歧因不可见特征变得不可判定；不经深思的LLM常隐性修复缺陷，而Claude高级模型能更常报告缺陷。

title: EPISTEME: Trustworthy Coding Agents Through Tool Call Intent
title_zh: 基于工具调用意图的可信编程代理
abstract: Coding agents change software through tool calls. Tool calls mutate the local state. For good? For bad? Nobody knows. Agents never say why a tool call is made. We propose the epistemic agent design, in which the harness guarantees that the model declares why a tool call is made. The harness then records what the command actually did and checks the self-reported declaration against these effects. The result is a journal 1) that can guard calls before they run and 2) that supports audits and forensics. For evaluation, we use ImpossibleBench, whose tasks can be passed only by cheating, and demonstrate that forcing the agents to say why results in exposed cheating. Across 49 reward-hacking runs of two open-weight models, the journal exposed 90%.
summary_zh: 编程代理执行工具调用时缺乏意图说明，导致其状态变更效果未知且不可信。
提出认知代理设计，强制模型声明调用意图，并记录实际效果以进行比对验证。
构建日志系统实现调用前防护与事后审计，在ImpossibleBench中揭露了90%的奖励作弊。

title: RAGAM-AI: A Hybrid Reinforcement Learning based Agentic approach powered by Generative AI for Edge Resource Management
title_zh: 基于混合强化学习与生成式AI的边缘资源管理智能体框架
abstract: Resource management for distributed edge networks hosting different services has been handled efficiently using Reinforcement learning (RL). Reward generalization in complex workflows is still an open issue within the RL realm. Therefore, this work proposes RAGAM-AI, a hybrid framework that combines the capabilities of RL algorithms and Generative-AI (Gen-AI) for powering an Agentic AI workflow that optimizes resource allocation at the Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) units. This framework further resolves the reward generalization issue by utilizing Large Language Model (LLM) for feedback. A Multi- Agent Soft-Actor Critic (MASAC) using MathΣtral as a reward oracle is implemented for managing resource allocations at the MEC. RAGAM-AI interprets system state information and evaluates multi-objective trade-offs guiding the resource orchestration loop over distributed edge server agents. The complexity of the framework is further brought down by incorporating surrogate reward model. The overall performance is evaluated against the single agent SAC, REINFORCE and random policies for benchmarking. On using RAGAM-AI, lower allocation deviations for CPU, memory and bandwidth resources are reported while minimizing the latency and data rate costs. A scalable AI as a feedback (AIAF) solution optimizing network resources with significant performance improvement is thus presented.
summary_zh: 多接入边缘计算资源分配中，RL处理复杂工作流时面临奖励泛化难题，需优化多目标权衡。
提出RAGAM-AI框架，结合RL与Gen-AI驱动Agentic工作流，利用LLM作为奖励预言机解决奖励泛化问题。
引入代理奖励模型降低复杂度。实验表明该框架降低了CPU等资源分配偏差，并最小化延迟与数据速率成本。

title: Who Gets Counted? Large Language Models, Informative Refusal, and Downstream Bias in Name-Based Demographic Classification
title_zh: 基于姓名的人口分类中LLM的缺失标签与下游偏差
abstract: Researchers routinely infer gender, race, and ethnicity from names, yet the standard tools used for this task misclassify the groups that diversity research most needs to measure. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as a remedy because they label diverse names accurately. We ask whether that accuracy carries over to the estimates researchers report. Across 10,000 Chinese names, 19,998 North Carolina voters with self-reported race, and 300 political science authors with human reference codes, we compare three LLMs with seven traditional tools and link the voter sample to party registration and age. Selective labeling explains part of the LLMs' accuracy advantage. Claude Haiku labels half of the voters, and a traditional tool limited to its most confident half is more accurate. Hard labels from every tool understate the White--Black gap in Democratic registration by 36% to 65%, while BIRDiE estimation on BISG posteriors comes within 0.03 of it. Haiku's missing labels select on age, inflating the age gap by six years. Combined with BISG, LLM answers sharpen individual labels without a demonstrated gain in BIRDiE accuracy. Classifiers should be judged by the estimates they produce, including the consequences of missing labels
summary_zh: 传统姓名推断工具常误判少数群体，虽LLM分类更准，但其准确性未必能转化为下游估计的可靠性。
LLM的准确优势部分源于选择性标注，限制传统工具的置信区间亦能提升准确率，且LLM缺失标签会扭曲年龄差距。
所有工具的硬标签均严重低估党派注册种族差距，结合BISG的BIRDiE估计更准，评估分类器应关注其产生的估计结果。

title: When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries
title_zh: LLM代理交接摘要何时变为指令：无依据的策略问题
abstract: Long-running LLM agents compact their context, replacing most history with a summary. We ask whether handoff summaries state permissions or requirements the record does not support, whether such sentences change what the next instance (the successor) does, and where they come from. Synthetic tool-use tasks carry a ground-truth permission ledger; same-snapshot replay reruns the successor with those whole sentences replaced by neutral filler. Two AI readers, reading only rule-flagged held-out summaries, confirmed unsupported restrictions in 1.2% and 2.4% of all readable summaries from two open-weight models, and unsupported authorizations in 0.1% and 1.3%. For restrictions, a pre-specified replay test was not significant (p = 0.58); a follow-up, planned after it, found a fragile effect (p = 0.027). Neutralizing false approvals cut unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 of 120 held-out runs (post hoc; later set: 17 to 11 of 48). Most development restrictions followed the agent's earlier reasoning that an action needs approval (post hoc). In pre-specified tests, replacing the system prompt's "Some actions need approval." with one saying where requirements come from cut unsupported restrictions from 5.0% to 1.8% of development summaries and, on held-out templates, from 1.8% to 0.3% (both p < 10^-9), while requests for approvals the ledger requires barely changed. Code and data: https://github.com/Chuw1/handoff-audit
summary_zh: 长期运行的LLM代理用交接摘要压缩上下文，但摘要可能包含历史记录无法支持的权限或限制。
通过合成任务与重放测试发现，摘要中存在少量无依据的限制与授权，且中和虚假授权可减少违规操作。
修改系统提示以明确限制来源，可将无依据限制的比例从5.0%降至1.8%，且几乎不影响合法审批请求。
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Chuw1/handoff-audit

title: EvoOPD: Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation
title_zh: 面向黑盒同策略蒸馏的特权信息策略演进方法
abstract: Proprietary language models exhibit strong reasoning and coding capabilities, but their output distributions are inaccessible, making fine-grained distillation methods that rely on teacher logits difficult to apply directly to black-box models. We observe that rich textual feedback from a black-box teacher can be treated as privileged information (PI) and converted, through a PI-conditioned privileged teacher, into dense supervision signals on the student's own trajectories. However, what PI should be acquired from the teacher to most effectively support student learning remains unclear. PI strategies that differ in where they focus, what information they request, and how much detail they provide can have substantially different effects on the current student, and their relative effectiveness can further change as training progresses. Based on this observation, we propose Evolving Privileged Information Strategies for Black-Box On-Policy Distillation (EvoOPD), which treats PI acquisition itself as an optimization problem and maintains a PI Strategy Bank that evolves with the student state. EvoOPD uses the measured repair utility of PI on the current student to adapt the focus, information type, and granularity of teacher feedback, allowing the acquired information to continually match the student's learning needs. We systematically evaluate EvoOPD on mathematical reasoning and code generation with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B students. EvoOPD achieves the best overall performance in all six model-task settings, improving over the strongest baseline in each setting by an average of 2.14 percentage points in mathematics and 1.30 points in code. Further analysis shows that the relative effectiveness of PI acquisition strategies changes with student state, making a fixed strategy difficult to sustain as the best choice throughout distillation.
summary_zh: 黑盒大模型输出分布不可访问，导致依赖教师 logits 的细粒度蒸馏难以直接应用。
不同特权信息（PI）获取策略对学生的效果随训练变化，本文将 PI 获取视为优化问题，提出 EvoOPD。
EvoOPD 维护随学生状态演进的 PI 策略库，自适应调整反馈，在数学与代码任务上平均提升 2.14 和 1.30 个百分点。

title: H^2MARL: Hierarchical Heterogeneous Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Robot Control
title_zh: H²MARL：用于人形机器人控制的层级异构多智能体强化学习
abstract: Coordinated whole-body control of humanoid robots remains challenging due to high-dimensional coupled dynamics and substantial physical heterogeneity across joint degrees of freedom (JDoFs). Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning methods either employ coarse agent partitions or directly apply generic heterogeneous-agent algorithms, while hierarchical controllers commonly optimize high-level planning and low-level execution independently, leading to uncoordinated motion. In this paper, we propose H^2MARL, a hierarchical heterogeneous multi-agent reinforcement learning framework with two key mechanisms. We first formulate humanoid whole-body control using a JDoF-level physical-heterogeneity-aware policy factorization, where each torque-actuated JDoF is conditioned on an explicit descriptor of its actuation, kinematic, and dynamic properties. Moreover, we develop a closed-loop policy-executor co-optimization mechanism that jointly adapts the high-level pose planner and the low-level joint executor using shared interaction trajectories, thereby reducing the distribution mismatch between planning and execution. Extensive experiments in MuJoCo and Isaac Gym demonstrate that H^2MARL consistently improves locomotion stability, gait coordination, and motion quality over homogeneous, coarse-grained, and independently optimized alternatives.
summary_zh: 人形机器人全身控制面临高维耦合动态与关节物理异构挑战，现有方法易导致运动不协调。
提出H²MARL框架，采用关节级物理异构感知策略分解，为每个关节提供其物理属性描述符。
引入闭环策略-执行器协同优化机制，联合优化高层规划与底层执行，消除分布不匹配，显著提升运动稳定性与协调性。

title: Deliberate Latent Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
title_zh: 面向序列推荐的深思熟虑隐式推理框架
abstract: Sequential recommenders are widely applied in real-world scenarios to model user preferences and behavior patterns based on user interactions. Recent advances in sequential recommendation enhance transformer-based models with latent reasoning to refine user representations by autoregressively generating intermediate reasoning vectors. However, exploring the optimal reasoning depth for diverse user histories remains challenging: existing methods typically employ a fixed number of reasoning steps for all users. This ``one-size-fits-all'' strategy often leads to suboptimal representation learning due to over-thinking in simple histories or under-thinking in complex ones. To address this issue, we propose DESRec, a deliberate latent reasoning framework that performs personalized latent reasoning to learn more informative reasoning states and enhance user modeling for sequential recommendation. Specifically, it designs a reasoning step selection module that identifies the optimal reasoning step for each user sequence during the training phase. Through a self-distillation mechanism, it compresses this most informative state into the final reasoning step, which serves as the final user representation for item ranking during inference. Moreover, it introduces a progressive preference extraction mechanism for personalized reasoning, which dynamically segments a user's history into a variable number of periods and summarizes each into a latent milestone representing the user's preference for that period. It will be used as the input of the subsequent reasoning. The number of milestones varies with the users' history, enabling a personalized reasoning over users' evolving interests. Extensive experimental results on six public datasets and four backbone recommenders demonstrate the superiority of DESRec over eight baseline models.
summary_zh: 现有隐式推理推荐采用固定推理步数，导致简单历史过度推理或复杂历史推理不足。
提出DESRec框架，设计推理步选择模块与自蒸馏机制，为每段历史压缩出最优推理步。
引入渐进偏好提取机制，动态划分历史生成可变里程碑，实现个性化隐式推理与用户建模。

title: Scythe: Semantic-Aware Rewriting for Fast,Effective Program Reduction
title_zh: Scythe：面向高效程序规约的语义感知重写
abstract: Automated program reduction shrinks a program into a smaller one that preserves a property of interest. Language-agnostic grammar-based reducers are easy to retarget across languages, but because they reason only about syntax, they cannot perform the coupled edits needed to remove whole declarations, e.g., a method cannot be deleted while it is still called. As a result, they waste oracle calls on edits that cannot succeed and often leave irrelevant declarations behind. We present SCYTHE, a fast, semantic-aware pre-processing step that runs in front of any grammar-based reducer without modifying it. SCYTHE encodes the program as a typed declaration dependency graph and applies a set of semantic-aware operators that decouple declarations from their use sites, making them removable while keeping the program well-typed. Fine-grained token-level minimization is then left to the downstream reducer. On 73 benchmarks across C, Java, and Solidity, combining SCYTHE with PERSES never yields a larger result than PERSES alone, and a strictly smaller one on 70 of 73 cases. On average, the combination produces programs 55.6% smaller (up to 95.5%) and is 2.3$\times$ faster (up to 7.4$\times$). SCYTHE also boosts LATRA, a reducer that, unlike the purely syntactic PERSES, also applies language-specific transformations: the combination produces programs 10.6% smaller (up to 61.8%) and is 2.4$\times$ faster on average. Video: https://youtu.be/uEq_YYU0zZw
summary_zh: 现有语法级程序规约器无法处理耦合编辑，常遗留无关声明并浪费预言机调用。
提出SCYTHE作为预处理步骤，构建声明依赖图并应用语义算子解耦声明，使其可删除且保持类型正确。
在73个基准测试上，结合下游规约器平均缩小程序55.6%且加速2.3倍，显著优于原方法。

title: Trace2Eval: Contextualized Evaluation of Coding Agents from Real-World Traces
title_zh: Trace2Eval：基于真实交互轨迹的编程Agent评估
abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used in real-world workflows across diverse domains, motivating evaluation grounded in real user tasks. Existing benchmarks, however, largely rely on static public tasks with reference patches or hidden tests. Next-generation coding-agent benchmarks should therefore move beyond correctness on fixed tasks toward continually renewed evaluation of overall artifact quality in real user workflows. We propose Trace2Eval, a dynamically updatable pipeline that constructs benchmarks from real-world interaction trajectories. Trace2Eval employs a multi-agent reconstruction system to analyze the filtered trajectory, recover the original user query, restore the workspace files to their pre-interaction state, and rebuild a trajectory-equivalent execution environment. A candidate agent then executes the reconstructed query to produce an initial artifact. To evaluate these artifacts, the pipeline iteratively refines human rubrics through inter-annotator alignment, and calibrates judge agents against human assessments using source-code and runtime evidence. Guided by feedback from the Trace2Eval pipeline, models revise their initial artifacts, yielding a mean score gain of 10.05 percentage points across 19 model-harness configurations and a maximum of 19.28 percentage points for DeepSeek-V4-Pro with Claude Code, which supports rubric feedback as actionable guidance for artifact improvement.
summary_zh: 现有编程Agent基准依赖静态任务，无法评估真实工作流中的产出质量。
提出Trace2Eval，利用多Agent系统从真实轨迹重构用户查询与执行环境，构建动态基准。
通过迭代对齐人工评分标准并校准评判Agent，提供可操作反馈，使模型产出评分平均提升10.05%。

title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
title_zh: 智能体潜在上下文压缩：工具输出无需文本表示
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents typically append raw tool outputs to their context. Over multi-step interactions, long and noisy observations incur substantial context overhead and dilute the agent's attention to task-relevant information. Existing token pruning and summarization methods remain constrained by discrete text representations, limiting the achievable compression ratios. In this work, we challenge the prevailing assumption that agents must consume tool observations as explicit text tokens. To this end, we propose Coca-Cola, a continuous latent context compression model for LLM agents. Coca-Cola compresses tool observations into latent tokens and embeds them into the input embedding space of the agent. We further introduce Action-Preserving Training, which aligns the agent's next-action distributions under full and compressed observations. This trains the compression model to learn action-sufficient latent tokens that retain decision-critical information. Experiments with web-search agents on four QA benchmarks and two model families show that Coca-Cola reduces the agent's token consumption by 70.01%-89.24% and end-to-end runtime by 24.45%-55.97%, while consistently improving task performance. These results suggest that Coca-Cola offers a promising approach for context compression in agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/THU-Agent/Coca-cola.
summary_zh: LLM智能体处理冗长工具输出会导致上下文开销大且分散注意力，现有文本压缩方法受限于离散表示。
提出Coca-Cola模型，将工具输出压缩为潜在token嵌入智能体输入空间，并引入动作保留训练对齐动作分布。
实验表明该方法降低70%-89%的token消耗及24%-55%的运行时间，且提升了任务性能。

title: Signed but Steerable: Measuring and Closing the Text-Vector Integrity Gap in Offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: 离线RAG的文本-向量完整性差距：测量与消除
abstract: Offline retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices is updated through signed knowledge packs that carry text and precomputed embedding vectors. A signature proves who published a pack, not that its vectors encode its text. We study this text-vector integrity gap. A verifier that recomputes vectors and accepts them within a cosine tolerance concedes a predictable share of queries to an attacker who controls the vectors: the hijack rate equals the distribution of angular retrieval margins at the tolerance (the margin law). Margins are small in five corpora and two embedding models, so an idealised tolerance at the level of floating-point noise leaves up to 5.5% of queries exposed (at most 1.2% in any corpus once exact duplicate documents are excluded), and a threshold calibrated from our CPU INT8-FP32 comparison of a small embedding model (at the empirical 0.1% quantile of honest cosines) leaves 98-100% exposed; on a Raspberry Pi 5 running a local language model, such an attack lowers correct answers from 0.75 to 0.39. Integrity audits of compressed vector stores fare no better: on a FAISS product-quantisation index over 57,638 documents, tampered vectors that all pass the audit put the attacker's document first for 25% of targets. Verifying quantisation codes instead, with ambiguity decided by the verifier, a calibrated guard band and canonicalisation, accepted every honest vector in our samples on three platforms and left the publisher no choice. We also show that common floating-point and dynamic-INT8 inference pipelines are not bit-reproducible across batch sizes or architectures, and report pre-registered negative results on abstention, context pruning and semantic screening. We release code and data.
summary_zh: 离线RAG的签名仅验证发布者，未验证向量是否编码对应文本，存在文本-向量完整性差距。
基于余弦容差重算向量的验证方法存在缺陷，在多种语料和模型下仍暴露最多5.5%的查询受劫持。
提出验证量化码并引入校准保护带与规范化方法，在多平台接受所有诚实向量且消除发布者作恶空间。
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/securagenai/signed-but-steerable (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23948839)

title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
title_zh: 多轮强化学习究竟提升了LLM智能体的什么能力？
abstract: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth $K$ and interaction depth $T$ via $Pass@(K,T)$, we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
summary_zh: 多轮智能体RL的性能提升对交互约束高度敏感，轨迹级优势随交互预算收紧而显著下降。
智能体RL并未均匀提升单步决策质量，其核心优势在于增强错误恢复与长程鲁棒性。
为缓解预算依赖风险，提出BudgetMix RL在训练中变化交互预算，实现跨设置的鲁棒性能。

title: ArcRAG: Agentic Compositional Retrieval over Knowledge Graphs
title_zh: ArcRAG：知识图谱上的智能组合检索
abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) answers questions by retrieving over a knowledge graph built from a corpus. Yet retrieval strategies are designed around the structure their own construction pipeline produces, and whether they survive a change of construction is rarely tested. We study this cross-construction portability: whether one retrieval procedure, with no construction-specific schema, relation names, or retuning, stays effective when the graph is built differently. We introduce ArcRAG, which induces a query-local graph interface at inference time (the node labels, relation descriptors, and property keys reachable from the entities a question names), plans multi-hop traversals against it, and executes and repairs them as Cypher. We build each of the MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and TriviaQA corpora as a schema-guided graph (typed nodes, a closed relation set, source provenance) and as an open-information-extraction graph (untyped nodes, free-text relations), with the retriever's configuration fixed across them. We compare against a construction-agnostic Direct-Cypher agent, ablate each stage across retry and pass budgets on both graph families, and compare with results reported for prior GraphRAG systems, most of which design retrieval together with their own graph construction. Across the two constructions, we find that retrieval need not be co-designed with the graph: query-time interface induction keeps a construction-agnostic retriever effective when the construction changes, although construction still shapes absolute accuracy.
summary_zh: 现有GraphRAG检索策略与图构建流程绑定，跨构建可移植性差，换图后常失效。
提出ArcRAG，在推理时生成查询局部图接口，规划多跳遍历并作为Cypher执行与修复。
实验表明检索无需与图构建协同设计，查询时接口归纳使检索器在图构建变化时仍有效。
现有GraphRAG检索策略与图构建流程绑定，跨构建可移植性差，换图后常失效。

title: Towards Early Warning of Real-World Vulnerabilities: An Evidence-Aware Decoupled Method for CVSS Vector Prediction Based on Unstructured Disclosures
title_zh: 面向真实漏洞早期预警：基于证据感知解耦的CVSS向量预测方法
abstract: Early assessment of Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) vectors from Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) can reduce the delay between initial public disclosure and official National Vulnerability Database (NVD) scoring. Existing predictors, trained mainly on standardized late-stage descriptions, degrade on noisy and incomplete pre-NVD reports. We introduce PARSE, a vulnerability-disclosure lifecycle model, and VPre, an early assessment framework built on two-level Evidence-Aware Decoupling. Decoupling Level I, Security-Evidence Screening, separates security-relevant evidence from noisy early reports at the report and sentence levels. Decoupling Level II, Evidence-Matched Routing, decouples the prediction task of the eight CVSS metrics into a scattered-evidence class and an explicit-evidence class based on validation-set measurements, matching each with a targeted predictor: large-language-model reasoning for the former, lightweight supervised classification for the latter. On the 851-report held-out test split of the 5,581-report VPre-Bench, VPre achieves a mean absolute error of 0.7239 -- 44.7% below the reproduced BERT-Small-NVD early-transfer baseline; paired timestamps across the full benchmark show an average 38-day lead before official scoring (observed range 21-60 days). Under the 38:1 PARSE-Triage noise setting, STDU's report-level screening reaches 0.98 precision, 1.00 recall, and 0.99 F1. Controlled ablations support the contributions of both decoupling levels.
summary_zh: 现有CVSS预测器在噪声大、不完整的早期漏洞报告上性能下降，无法实现早期预警。
提出VPre框架，通过两级证据感知解耦：先筛选安全证据，再按证据类型将预测任务路由至LLM推理或监督分类。
在VPre-Bench上，VPre平均绝对误差较基线降低44.7%，比官方评分平均提前38天，验证了方法有效性。
comment: 21 pages, 12 figures; includes 3 pages of supplementary material

title: KDASO: Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization for Liability Adjudication Tasks
title_zh: 面向责任裁定任务的知识与数据双驱动自动技能优化
abstract: Liability adjudication tasks (e.g., legal charge determination) require analyzing event descriptions against domain-specific skills to determine whether a party should bear liability. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in this area by leveraging executable skills for interpretable reasoning, existing approaches face three critical limitations: skill libraries become stale as real-world scenarios dynamically evolve, skill descriptions often suffer from a semantic execution gap where LLMs deviate from intended expert logic, and growing skill collections exceed context budgets causing critical skill omission. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization (KDASO), which continuously evolves a skill library through neighborhood-conditioned induction from recent adjudication data, execution-aligned refinement based on LLM trajectory analysis, and context-budgeted routing for scalable skill selection. Experiments across ride-hailing adjudication, legal liability determination, and logical reasoning judgment demonstrate that KDASO significantly outperforms current general-purpose and domain-specific baselines. KDASO further achieves 8.96% improvement when transferring skills to concept-similar scenarios and maintains consistent performance gains through continuous optimization, underscoring the high transferability and stability of generated skills.
summary_zh: 责任裁定中，LLM使用的技能库存在过时、语义执行偏差及超出上下文预算导致遗漏的问题。
提出KDASO框架，通过数据归纳、执行对齐精炼和上下文预算路由，实现技能库自动持续演进。
实验表明KDASO显著优于基线，迁移至相似场景提升8.96%，且持续优化性能稳定。

title: SUMONE: A Simple and Efficient Summarizer for Plug-and-Play Agent Memory
title_zh: SUMONE：即插即用Agent记忆的高效摘要器
abstract: Long-horizon language-model agents accumulate increasingly large interaction histories, making context compaction essential for efficient execution. Existing learned compaction methods often rely on downstream task outcomes or solver behavior, coupling training to specific tasks or agents. We introduce SumOne, a standalone summarizer trained to preserve information in agent histories through masked reconstruction. Given a summary of the expired history, a frozen reconstructor recovers randomly masked portions of the original trajectory; reconstruction quality, combined with a length penalty, provides a task-agnostic reward for optimizing the summarizer with GRPO. This yields self-supervision directly from raw trajectories, without reference summaries or downstream task execution. At inference time, only the lightweight summarizer is retained, enabling plug-and-play context compression for otherwise unchanged agents. We conduct a systematic evaluation of SumOne in long-horizon search and software-engineering tasks. SumOne reduces estimated inference cost by approximately 78\% on DeepSearchQA and 75\% on SWE-bench Verified relative to operating with full context, with absolute decreases of 0.04. The same checkpoint also transfers across downstream models and agent harnesses without additional fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 长时序Agent交互历史过长需压缩，现有方法依赖特定任务，本文提出独立摘要器SumOne。
通过冻结重构器对掩码轨迹的恢复质量与长度惩罚，提供任务无关奖励，用GRPO优化摘要器。
SumOne实现即插即用压缩，推理成本降约75%-78%，性能仅降0.04，且可零微调跨模型迁移。

title: Understanding the Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs
title_zh: 大模型思维链推理的分布外泛化机制研究
abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored. We study CoT as compositional OOD generalization: the target task lacks complete reasoning trajectories or direct input-output pairs, while training provides only in-distribution (ID) atomic step data. We show that CoT generalizes by repeatedly applying a shared single-step predictor to compose reusable ID transitions. Theoretically, let $T$ denote the number of reasoning steps in the target task, $n$ the number of training samples per sub-task, and $k$ the number of output tokens per step; then the OOD task risk is controlled by the sum of the ID sub-task risks, scaled by a coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$ that is independent of $T$, although the summed risk itself may still grow with $T$. A Rademacher-complexity analysis further shows that the estimation term is of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T/n})$, rather than linear in $T$, due to predictor sharing under a uniform capacity control on the shared class. For autoregressive Next-Token Prediction, the final-task risk is bounded by the best-in-class step-level risk scaled by the same coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$, plus an estimation term of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(k\sqrt{T/n}\big)$. A parity-coupled construction further shows that, for the sub-task empirical risk minimizer, the expected final-task risk is at least the best in-class risk plus $Ω(\sqrt{T/n})$ when $T\le n$. Experiments on Atom-Task and GSM8K support the theory: CoT enables short-to-long and compositional generalization, while explicit state tracking is crucial. Our code is available at https://github.com/maxliang114514/CoT-OOD.
summary_zh: 问题：CoT推理的分布外泛化机制缺乏理论探索，目标任务缺乏完整轨迹或直接数据对。
方法：将CoT视为组合泛化，通过共享单步预测器重复应用可复用的分布内转移，并进行Rademacher复杂度分析。
结论：OOD任务风险由ID子任务风险与O(k)系数控制，估计项为O(√(T/n))而非线性增长，实验验证了短到长泛化。

title: Entropogram-guided Visual Realignment Decoding: Capturing the Rhythm of Multimodal Reasoning
title_zh: 基于信息熵图的视觉重对齐解码：捕捉多模态推理节奏
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress on cross-modal reasoning tasks, yet they continue to suffer from hallucinations in long-chain reasoning processes. In this work, we revisit hallucination in MLLMs from the perspective of reasoning generation dynamics. We argue that entropy is not merely a static measure of uncertainty but a structured signal that reflects how modality information is integrated throughout decoding. Through systematic analysis, we identify two characteristic entropy patterns associated with hallucination behaviors: (1) a generally high-confidence regime corresponds to premature convergence to inappropriate multimodal interactions; and (2) local abrupt entropy transitions are associated with reasoning instability and hallucination onset. Building on these observations, we propose an entropy-aware self-introspective framework for MLLM reasoning. Our method continuously tracks entropy dynamics during decoding and performs targeted visual re-alignment when suspicious hallucination states are detected, encouraging the model to re-examine salient visual evidence at critical reasoning stages. Extensive experiments across six multimodal reasoning benchmarks spanning nine distinct evaluation settings demonstrate that our approach delivers robust improvements in reasoning accuracy and hallucination robustness, while providing new insights into the generation dynamics underlying MLLM failures. The code is available at: https://github.com/jden4524/SelfRetrospectiveDecoding.
summary_zh: MLLM在长链推理中易生幻觉，本文从推理生成动态视角将其归结为熵的静态误用。
发现幻觉对应两种熵模式：高置信早收敛于不当交互，局部熵突变引发推理失稳。
提出熵感知自省框架，解码时追踪熵动态并在可疑处重对齐视觉证据，有效提升准确性与鲁棒性。

title: Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents
title_zh: LLM Agent间的零样本协调
abstract: We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known about the performance of LLM agents despite their increasing deployment in such settings. Existing work on LLM coordination often relies on specialised scaffolding that independently developed agents are unlikely to share in practice. Moreover, evaluations on complex environments (e.g., Hanabi) make it difficult to pinpoint the sources of coordination failure. In contrast, we focus on simple, general-purpose scaffolds in minimal environments designed to isolate specific coordination challenges. Our results show that even in these controlled settings, frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner's beliefs. While LLMs introduce semantic information as an additional axis for coordination, they nonetheless fail to exploit this structure effectively. Towards this, we propose Coordination-friendly definitions (CFDs) as a principled approach for enabling robust coordination among LLM agents. Finally, we show that CFDs can be discovered automatically, removing the need for manual engineering. Code is available at https://github.com/ahayler/zsc-llm-agents.
summary_zh: 现有LLM协调研究依赖专用脚手架且环境复杂，难以定位协调失败根源，本文改用通用脚手架与极简环境来隔离特定协调挑战。
实验发现前沿LLM在受控环境中仍难以协调，主因是对协调问题理解受限及对伙伴信念推理薄弱，且未能有效利用语义信息。
提出协调友好定义（CFDs）以实现LLM agent间的鲁棒协调，并证明CFDs可自动发现，无需人工设计。
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Poster. ICLR 26 MALGAI Workshop Oral. The first two authors contributed equally

title: MA-Mesh: Resilient Multi-Agent Collaboration via Role-based Self-Healing
title_zh: MA-Mesh：基于角色的自愈式多智能体协作框架
abstract: Effective collaboration in multi-agent systems requires mechanisms for coordination and adaptability in dynamic and uncertain environments. However, existing multi-agent systems rarely model resilience explicitly, instead relying on ad-hoc output correction that limits systematic, runtime management of robustness. In this work, we propose Multi-Agent Mesh (MA-Mesh), a framework that constructs a role-based self-healing layer on top of a collaboration pattern. Specifically, MA-Mesh generates resilience-aware system specifications and synthesizes them into executable multi-agent policy code. To enhance resilience, we introduce two self-healing mechanisms: Cross-agent reflection, a mechanism that allows agents to evaluate not only their own outcomes but also the performance of their peers, enabling informed behavioral adjustments and collective policy refinement; Role-based failover, a strategy which dynamically reassigns roles and enables agents to substitute for one another when sub-tasks fail or agents underperform, ensuring continuity of task execution. Experimental results across diverse tasks (e.g., software development, tool use, scientific reasoning) demonstrate that MA-Mesh significantly outperforms existing multi-agent systems in both task performance and robustness under system uncertainty.
summary_zh: 现有系统缺乏显式韧性建模，仅靠临时纠错，难以实现系统级鲁棒性管理。
提出MA-Mesh框架，生成韧性感知规范并合成策略代码，构建基于角色的自愈层。
引入跨智能体反思与角色故障转移机制，实验表明该框架显著提升任务性能与鲁棒性。

title: From hydrological laws to catchment models: A process-based model matches deep-learning accuracy on three continents
title_zh: 从水文定律到流域模型：基于过程的模型在三洲匹敌深度学习精度
abstract: Dooge asked whether hydrology has laws at the catchment scale. We ask whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can match the accuracy of neural networks that outperform process-based models on the same inputs. Three laws constrain a lumped catchment model. Conservation makes it a flux-connected storage network, dissipation fixes the sign of every flux and aggregation determines how the unresolved composition enters the fluxes, through effective laws over threshold distributions and a memory of the forcing. These laws admit four kinds of refinement. A parsimonious model under them, CaRT (11 parameters per catchment), is refined in a loop assisted by AI agents. Each refinement addresses an observed deficit through a hypothesis from the literature. The result, CaRT+, has fourteen states, 35 parameters per catchment and no daily neural network. Most refinements follow from aggregation over thresholds or from variables that carry no water but modulate fluxes. On 602 British and 593 US gauged catchments, single CaRT+ models reach median Nash-Sutcliffe efficiencies of 0.863 and 0.765 in held-out years. A stateful LSTM reaches 0.869 and 0.751 and an entity-aware LSTM 0.862 and 0.754, while three-seed LSTM ensembles remain ahead of the CaRT+ ensemble by 0.003-0.012 in median paired NSE. On 505 drier Australian gauged catchments unused in development, single CaRT+ models reach 0.778 against 0.762 and 0.753 for the two LSTMs. The results suggest that catchment-scale laws exist as laws of form, with the constitutive families shared and only their parameters learned.
summary_zh: 传统过程模型精度不及神经网络，探究基于物理定律的低维系统能否匹敌神经网络精度。
基于守恒、耗散与聚合定律构建精简模型CaRT，并在AI agent辅助下通过文献假设循环修正缺陷，得到CaRT+模型。
在英美澳602、593和505个流域上，CaRT+精度与LSTM相当，表明流域尺度存在形式定律，仅需学习参数。
comment: 61 pages, 12 figures, 13 tables, plus 19 pages of Supporting Information

title: LegalEvolver: Agentic Legal Judgment Prediction via Rubric-Guided Self-Evolution
title_zh: 基于评分准则引导自演化的法律判决预测智能体
abstract: As LLM-based agents develop, they have been increasingly applied in the legal domain. Legal Judgment Prediction~(LJP) requires models to conduct multi-step reasoning and external legal evidence retrieval. Existing legal search agents' performance is often constrained by the quality of retrieval queries. They often formulate queries directly from the initial user request, overlooking latent legal issues and legally salient details. To address this issue, we propose \emph{LegalEvolver}, a query optimization framework specifically designed to generate legally informative queries for LJP-oriented retrieval. Sampling high-quality optimized queries and their corresponding search trajectories is challenging, as relying solely on unguided high-temperature rollouts is both inefficient and constrained by the model's initial capabilities. We therefore heuristically optimize queries as seeds, improving the efficiency of trajectory generation. Furthermore, we summarize rollout experience into rubrics and use them to guide multi-round iterative self-evolution. Iteratively performing rubric optimization and rubric-guided RL enables the model to surpass its initial performance ceiling. End-to-end performance on extensive benchmarks demonstrates the effectiveness of query optimization on LJP. Comparisons with direct SFT followed by RL demonstrate the effectiveness of rubric guidance. Evolving rubrics further outperform fixed rubrics, confirming the benefits of self-evolution.
summary_zh: 现有法律检索智能体直接构建查询，易遗漏潜在法律问题与关键细节，限制了法律判决预测性能。
提出LegalEvolver框架，启发式优化查询作为种子提升轨迹生成效率，并总结经验为评分准则引导多轮自演化。
评分准则引导的强化学习使模型突破初始性能上限，演化准则优于固定准则，验证了自演化与查询优化的有效性。

title: Corralling AI Risks with Grassroots Contracts
title_zh: 用草根契约约束AI风险
abstract: AI's inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks. Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content: (1) AI control of global platforms, social and economic, used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control. (2) Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability. (3) Unattributed deepfakes generated by anonymous AI, with people unable to distinguish them from genuine content and with their producers evading accountability and culpability. Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts, a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon. We present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents and for a social network with digital provenance, and working smartphone apps that implement the two and show how they corral these major AI risks: (1) AI control of global platforms. (2) Unaccountable AI agents. (3) Unattributed deepfakes.
summary_zh: 数字平台面临三大AI风险：AI控制平台、匿名且不可问责的AI agent，以及无法溯源的深度伪造。
提出基于两百年前Proudhon理念的草根契约，作为约束上述AI风险的数字实现方案。
构建含可问责AI agent的社会图与含数字溯源的社交网络，并开发手机应用验证其能有效约束三大风险。

title: Give Up to Get More: Priors, Not Policies, Govern Test-Time Compute Allocation
title_zh: 放弃以求更多：先验而非策略决定测试时算力分配
abstract: When many inputs share a budget of repeated attempts by a large language model (LLM), a common rule gives harder inputs more. On public math, code and formal-proof samples, the best published difficulty-proportional rule captures half or more of the oracle gain on benchmarks the model mostly solves, but at most 13% on hard workloads, even given true pass rates. Because the value of one more attempt peaks at intermediate difficulty, the optimal static allocation is inverted-U and gives little to inputs that are hopeless at the current budget. In a strict survey of 221 LLM allocation papers, at least 13 give the hardest inputs the most attempts; their easier settings sit at budgets where this is near-optimal, so the cost appears on harder workloads. Acting on it requires knowing which inputs are solvable, so information, not the policy, drives the gain. With a verifier and a prior from a related model's past runs on the same inputs, Thompson Sampling raises the solved share on the hardest workload from 14% to 27%; without such a prior, no policy we tested beats round-robin. For the policies we tested, the gain vanishes between prior rank correlations of about 0.3 and 0.55, which cheap text-based priors barely reach on the weakest models, and it requires a verifier whose false acceptances are rare relative to the pass rate. On new Qwen2.5 samples the pattern holds, and tempering the prior avoids losses on easy workloads. We turn these results into a decision guide.
summary_zh: 问题：传统按难度分配LLM重试预算的规则在困难任务上收益极低，最多仅达oracle增益的13%。
方法：最优静态分配呈倒U型，应放弃当前预算下无望的输入；采用Thompson Sampling结合相关模型先验进行分配。
结论：算力分配增益由先验信息而非策略驱动；有先验时Thompson Sampling将最难任务解决率从14%提至27%，无先验时无策略优于轮询。
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures. Code, results and survey coding: https://github.com/nepersoned/priors-not-policies

title: Traffic-VL: Reinforced Vision-Language Models for Generalizable End-to-End Traffic Signal Control
title_zh: Traffic-VL：面向通用端到端交通信号控制的强化视觉语言模型
abstract: Existing traffic signal control methods typically rely on structured traffic states produced by dedicated perception pipelines. Emerging visual approaches often use idealized simulator images and convert them into intermediate representations before control, limiting their ability to directly exploit roadside visual observations. To bridge both the visual-domain and perception-to-decision gaps, we introduce SynTra-V and Traffic-VL. SynTra-V converts physics-based traffic simulations into photorealistic multi-view surveillance imagery across diverse road topologies and sensing conditions, and automatic semantic auditing checks that control-critical geometry, vehicle movements, and lane semantics match the simulator state. Traffic-VL is an eight-billion-parameter vision-language model that directly maps synchronized multi-view images and natural-language phase descriptions to signal decisions without intermediate structured states. Building on Traffic-R1's two-stage reinforced reasoning framework, Traffic-VL adapts its vision encoder via offline reinforcement learning on SynTra-V and freezes it during online visual stepwise trajectory policy optimization in closed-loop simulation. Experiments show that Traffic-VL matches structured-state Traffic-R1 while outperforming image-based controllers and general-purpose vision-language models, including Gemini 3 Pro. Evaluations on unseen topologies, degraded sensing conditions, real surveillance footage, and a three-week deployment across ten intersections further demonstrate robust visual generalization and effective constrained online control.
summary_zh: 现有视觉交通信号控制方法依赖理想化图像与中间表示，难以直接利用路侧视觉观测，存在视觉域与感知决策鸿沟。
提出SynTra-V生成多视角真实图像并审计语义一致性，结合Traffic-VL直接将多视角图像与文本映射为信号决策。
实验表明Traffic-VL性能媲美结构化方法，优于图像控制器及通用VLM，并在未见拓扑、真实视频与实际部署中展现强泛化性。

title: EvoCodeAgent: Project-Level Code Generation via Architecture-Code Co-Evolution and Experience-Guided Repair
title_zh: EvoCodeAgent：基于架构-代码协同演化与经验引导修复的项目级代码生成
abstract: Project-level code generation aims to automatically synthesize complete software repositories from high-level requirements, producing coherent multi-file systems with well-structured modules and consistent cross-file dependencies. Despite the strong capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in specification understanding and code synthesis, existing approaches still exhibit several critical limitations. First, many methods rely on static architectural designs that cannot adapt during iterative generation, leading to a growing misalignment between architecture and implementation. Second, they lack mechanisms to accumulate and reuse experience across iterations, resulting in recurring errors and reduced efficiency. Third, they often depend on standalone LLM-based evaluation of intermediate artifacts, which suffer from limited transparency and potential unreliability under long-context reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose EvoCodeAgent, a state-centric framework for project-level code generation. EvoCodeAgent maintains an evolving architectural state initialized from structured project specifications and continuously reconciles predicted relations from architecture and skeletons with realized relations extracted from generated code. It further uses tool-grounded verification evidence to support reliable state updates and abstracts reusable repair experiences from previous revision attempts to guide subsequent generation. Extensive experiments on project-level benchmarks of different scales, including DevBench and CodeProjectEval, demonstrate that EvoCodeAgent consistently outperforms baseline approaches. Under the GPT-5 setting, it achieves unit test pass rates of 60.48% and 27.73%, respectively, yielding up to a 53.5% improvement over the strongest baseline.
summary_zh: 现有项目级代码生成存在架构与实现失准、缺乏经验复用及评估不可靠的问题，提出EvoCodeAgent框架。
该框架维护动态演化的架构状态，持续对齐预测与已生成代码的实际关系，并使用工具验证保障状态更新。
抽象可复用的修复经验指导后续生成，实验表明在GPT-5下单元测试通过率最高提升53.5%，优于基线。

title: Beyond Scene Shortcuts: Action-Centric Video-Text Alignment for Fine-Grained Action Understanding
title_zh: 超越场景捷径：面向细粒度动作理解的动作中心视频文本对齐
abstract: Fine-grained action understanding requires vision-language models to ground what an agent does, how it acts, and why it acts in spatio-temporal evidence. However, richer supervision can backfire: fine-tuned models may generate detailed action descriptions grounded in static scenes and salient objects rather than motion, a failure we call Environment-Grounded Action Hallucination (EGAH). To mitigate EGAH, we propose Staged Attention Rectification and Reinforcement (STARR), an action-centric video-text alignment framework that breaks scene-action shortcuts through Action-Environment Dissociation and reinforces action-focused grounding with an Attention Consistency Reward within Group Relative Policy Optimization. We further construct FineActionR&R, combining temporally localized captions with hierarchical and temporal-causal reasoning data. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, FineActionVLM-R1 improves average MotionBench accuracy by 3.01 percentage points over its base model and achieves 91.50% on HAU-MCQ-Bench. Qualitative comparisons further indicate more faithful fine-grained action descriptions with fewer environment-induced hallucinations.
summary_zh: 细粒度动作理解中，微调模型易依赖静态场景生成描述，导致环境诱发动作幻觉（EGAH）。
提出STARR框架，通过动作-环境解耦打破场景捷径，并用注意力一致性奖励强化动作聚焦。
构建FineActionR&R数据集，基于此训练的模型在MotionBench提升3.01个百分点，有效减少幻觉。

title: A.S.E 2.0: Understanding How Repository Context Impacts the Security of LLM-Generated Code
title_zh: A.S.E 2.0：探究仓库上下文对LLM生成代码安全性的影响
abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agents construct a repository context before generating code. For security-sensitive code, this context decides whether the model sees the project's safeguards (e.g., authorization checks) or insecure code to imitate. However, context construction is designed almost exclusively for functional correctness, and secure-code benchmarks treat the context as fixed, so how repository context affects the security of generated code remains unclear. We construct CASE-Bench, a benchmark of 145 repository-level tasks from real CVEs in 51 projects. Each task runs in Docker, has functional tests and a proof-of-concept exploit validated in both directions, and is annotated with the repository code that enforces or undermines its security. Using CASE-Bench, we compare 13 context construction methods and six controls with six LLMs, edit single context elements, and analyze coding-agent trajectories. We find that (1) functionality-oriented context raises the functional pass rate by up to 8.2 percentage points (pp) but the secure pass rate by at most 3.7 pp, (2) withholding a safeguard lowers the secure pass rate by up to 8.1 pp, while one inserted insecure exemplar raises correct-but-exploitable code by 6.3 pp, and (3) coding agents observe the relevant safeguard in only 27-36% of trajectories. These findings inform security-aware context construction and secure-code evaluation.
summary_zh: 现有LLM代码助手的仓库上下文构建仅关注功能正确性，其对生成代码安全性的影响尚不明确。
构建CASE-Bench基准，包含145个真实CVE任务，对比13种上下文构建方法与6个LLM。
发现功能导向上下文对安全提升有限；移除防护或引入不安全示例均显著降低代码安全性。

title: MonoLaDN: Language-Guided DeNoising for Monocular 3D Object Detection
title_zh: MonoLaDN：面向单目3D目标检测的语言引导去噪
abstract: Monocular 3D object detection offers a low-cost route to 3D perception, but it remains fundamentally ill-posed, since depth must be inferred from a single view. Recent transformer-based detectors learn geometry purely from image features and 3D box annotations, lacking the high-level semantic priors that vision-language models (VLMs) acquire from large-scale pretraining. VLMs offer such priors, but deploying one directly as a detector is impractical due to its heavy inference cost. We propose MonoLaDN, a language-guided denoising framework that transfers the geometric reasoning of a VLM into a monocular 3D detector while keeping the deployed model purely vision-based. During training, a frozen VLM produces structured reasoning about each object's occlusion, depth, dimension, and angle from the image and its ground-truth boxes. We encode this reasoning into queries, perturb them with noise, and train the detector to reconstruct the clean reasoning. Reconstructing the corrupted reasoning forces the detector's depth-guided features to internalize the VLM's geometric priors, so this knowledge remains available even after the reasoning path is discarded at inference, adding no latency or parameters to the deployed model. Experiments on KITTI 3D and nuScenes show that MonoLaDN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art detectors and generalizes well to new domains.
summary_zh: 单目3D检测因深度推断不适定而困难，现有方法缺乏VLM的高层语义先验，且直接部署VLM推理成本过高。
提出MonoLaDN框架，训练时用冻结VLM生成结构化几何推理，对其加噪并训练检测器重建，以转移VLM先验。
该方法使纯视觉检测器内化几何先验，推理时无额外延迟与参数，在KITTI和nuScenes上优于SOTA且泛化性强。
